jobs.description:
Overview:

Thank you for considering IT Concepts dba Kentro, where innovation drives opportunity and collaboration leads to success. Our dynamic community of experts is fully committed to advancing our customers' missions, fostering professional growth, and making a positive impact on our communities.  

By joining our supportive community, you will find that Kentro is dedicated to your personal and professional development. Together, we can drive meaningful change, spark innovation, and achieve extraordinary milestones.  

Kentro is hiring for **Remote Risk Management Project Manager** to support the **VA ESOM contract**. Kentro is seeking a Project Manager to lead the disaster recovery exercise team supporting the Department of Veterans Affairs ESOM program. The project manager will direct the team’s schedule, priorities, delivery commitments, risks, and stakeholder coordination. This role will also serve as Scrum Master by facilitating team ceremonies, maintaining the work backlog, removing delivery impediments, and supporting continuous improvement. The project manager is accountable for the quality and timely delivery of exercise plans, tabletop sessions, reports, and corrective action tracking. **Location:** Remote \- This position can be performed remotely within the United States and will support Eastern Time working hours. **Compensation Range:** The pay range for this position is $155\-$170K annually. Kentro determines compensation by evaluating current government contracting and commercial market conditions, as well as the role’s specific requirements. Final salary placement within this range will be based on the candidate’s relevant skills, experience, education, certifications, location, and security clearance level, where applicable.  

This Job Description reflects the primary duties of the role; however, it is not intended to be all‑inclusive. Team members may be asked to take on additional responsibilities in alignment with customer expectations, business needs, and Kentro’s culture of collaboration and adaptability.
Responsibilities:
* Lead the multidisciplinary team of cyber engineering, operational resilience, risk analysis, and technical writing personnel.
* Develop and maintain the integrated schedule for application assessments, tabletop exercises, reports, and follow\-up validation.
* Set delivery priorities with program leadership and application stakeholders based on application criticality, risk, and available resources.
* Define work packages, owners, milestones, dependencies, acceptance criteria, and reporting requirements.
* Serve as Scrum Master by facilitating planning, daily coordination, backlog refinement, reviews, and retrospectives.
* Maintain the team backlog and make work status, blockers, risks, and dependencies visible to stakeholders.
* Remove delivery impediments and coordinate decisions that require program, technical, or customer leadership.
* Ensure exercises follow approved objectives, methods, documentation standards, and quality reviews.
* Review exercise plans, after\-action reports, improvement plans, dashboards, and leadership briefings before delivery.
* Track program risks, corrective actions, performance measures, staffing, and stakeholder commitments.
* Facilitate communication among the team, application owners, technical organizations, security personnel, vendors, and leadership.
* Promote practical process improvements based on retrospectives, exercise results, and stakeholder feedback.


Qualifications:
* Bachelor’s degree in project management, information systems, business administration, engineering, or another relevant discipline.
* 10 years of relevant experience.
* 8 years of additional relevant experience may be substituted for education.
* Experience leading multidisciplinary technology, cybersecurity, resilience, or disaster recovery teams.
* Experience managing schedules, risks, dependencies, deliverables, quality reviews, and executive reporting.
* Experience serving as a Scrum Master or leading work through an Agile delivery framework.
* Ability to facilitate technical and leadership meetings, resolve delivery impediments, and maintain stakeholder alignment.
* Strong leadership, organization, communication, negotiation, and problem\-solving skills.

  

**Preferred Qualifications:*** Project Management Professional, Certified ScrumMaster, Professional Scrum Master, or comparable certification.
* Experience managing disaster recovery, operational resilience, business continuity, or cybersecurity exercise programs.
* Familiarity with NIST SP 800\-34, NIST SP 800\-84, NIST SP 800\-53, and federal IT governance practices.
* Experience with Agile planning, collaboration, reporting, and service management tools.
* Background supporting large federal, DoD, or public\-sector IT environments.

**Clearance Requirement:*** US Citizen or Lawful Permanent Resident (Green Card)
* Willing and able to obtain and maintain Public Trust Clearance
* Must meet updated ID requirements: https://www.gsa.gov/technology/it\-contract\-vehicles\-and\-purchasing\-programs/federal\-credentialing\-services/get\-appointment\-help/bring\-required\-documents

jobs.description:
**Palantir Foundry Data Analyst**  

We need an experienced Palantir Foundry Data Analyst at the National Guard Bureau (NGB). The NGB is the link between the Army and Air National Guard and the Department of War (DoW). You will support operations on the Minuteman project team, which manages the NGB's enterprise data environment within the DoW's central analytics platform, and solves real\-world problems through app development, geospatial analysis, and data summarization directly enabling smarter, faster decision\-making for end users. In this role, you will build within Palantir Foundry applications including Workshop, Ontology Manager, and Gaia to streamline workflows, create dynamic apps, map geospatial data, and summarize insights, translating complex requirements into efficient workflows and easy\-to\-use applications while working with mission stakeholders and end users to refine and deliver impactful products. This is a full\-time opportunity. We can offer a competitive salary, and a comprehensive benefits package.
  

  

**RESPONSIBILITIES*** Build and deliver applications within Palantir Foundry using Workshop, Ontology Manager, and Gaia
* Analyze, explore, clean, and visualize complex mission datasets to produce actionable insights
* Develop maps and geospatial analytics within Palantir Foundry to support operational analysis
* Apply data summarization tools, including AI\-powered (AIP) capabilities, to surface insights quickly
* Translate complex mission requirements into efficient workflows and easy\-to\-use Foundry applications
* Work collaboratively with mission stakeholders and end users to refine and deliver impactful applications and insights
* Apply data storytelling, visualization, and user experience (UX) design principles so findings are clear and usable
* Research, design, and develop software and specialized utility programs in support of mission requirements
* Analyze user needs and develop software solutions, applying principles and techniques of computer science, engineering, and mathematical analysis
* Update and enhance existing software capabilities
* Develop specifications and performance requirements, coordinating with engineering counterparts to integrate hardware and software systems as required
* Maintain databases within the application area, working individually or coordinating database development as part of a team
* Streamline workflows and support DoW operations on the Minuteman project team to enable faster, better\-informed decisions

  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS*** Three (3\) to ten (10\) years of directly related experience
* 3\+ years of experience with data analysis, exploration, visualization, or cleaning
* 3\+ years of experience building within Palantir Foundry applications, including Workshop, Ontology Manager, and Gaia
* Experience with data summarization tools, including AI\-powered (AIP) tools
* Experience building maps and geospatial analytics within Palantir Foundry
* Experience with data storytelling, visualization, and user experience (UX) design
* Ability to translate complex requirements into efficient workflows or easy\-to\-use applications in Foundry
* Ability to work collaboratively with mission stakeholders and end users to refine and deliver impactful applications and insights

  

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS*** Experience with the Department of War (DoW) mission and associated datasets
* Experience with Advana, Databricks, Power BI, Qlik, or Tableau in a DoD environment
* Prior experience supporting OUSD Personnel \& Readiness (P\&R) or National Guard Bureau (NGB) missions

  

**EDUCATION*** B.A./B.S. or M.A./M.S. in Data Analytics, Information Systems, or Business Intelligence

  

**LOCATION*** National Capital Region. One day onsite in Arlington, VA – Preferred
* Fully remote \- Acceptable

  

**CLEARANCE*** Active Secret security clearance
* U.S. citizenship is required since this role supports the U.S. Federal government

  

**CLIENT*** OUSD Personnel \& Readiness (P\&R), Minuteman project team

  

**WORK HOURS*** 40 hours per week. 8 hours per day

  

**EMPLOYMENT CLASSIFICATION*** Employment Classification Eligibility — W2

  

**COMPENSATION*** Salary range: $155,000 \- $165,000
* Benefits: Benefits package includes options for health, dental, and vision insurance coverage; 401k contribution options

***West 4th Strategy is an Equal Opportunity (EEO) employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, creed, religion, gender, sexual orientation, ancestry, national origin, age, marital status, mental disability, physical disability, medical condition, pregnancy, political affiliation, military or veteran status, or any other basis prohibited by federal or state law.***

**Summary:**


**Overview**

Every year, millions of animals enter shelters across the United States \- and the data behind their stories has the power to transform how shelters and communities care for them. As Senior Data Analyst at Shelter Animals Count (a Program of the ASPCA), you'll be at the center of the nation's most comprehensive effort to collect, analyze, and share animal sheltering data. Your work will put credible, well\-documented data into the hands of shelters, researchers, media, and national partners \- and help ensure the quality and integrity of the dataset behind the field's most important estimates and insights. If you're a highly organized analyst who loves working with real\-world data and wants your skills to drive real\-world impact for animals and the communities that serve them, this is your role.


The Senior Data Analyst reports to the Senior Manager, Data Science, and will work closely with other members of the Shelter Animals Count (SAC) and broader Strategy team. They will serve as the point person and end\-to\-end owner of SAC's data request pipeline \- leading the intake, scoping, execution, and delivery of data \& analysis requests from internal stakeholders and external partners \- while leading data quality investigations and contributing to machine learning, statistical modeling, and analysis projects. They will serve as the key point of contact for a diverse group of stakeholders, external partners, interns, contractors, and vendors to prioritize and execute on insights and data requests, providing prescriptive analytics to numerous animal welfare topics. They will bring a high level of organization, accuracy, and integrity to data analysis and reporting.


**Who We Are**


Shelter Animals Count (SAC) is a nationally recognized brand dedicated to collecting, analyzing, and sharing data on animal sheltering across the United States and Canada, and will join the ASPCA’s Strategy Team. The Strategy department has five verticals: Strategy and Planning, Research, Impact Measurement and Data Science, Project Management Office, and SAC. The Strategy team uses strategic and data\-driven processes to guide organizational direction, drive effective decision\-making, and deliver actionable, evidence\-based insights to shelters and communities. Strategy serves as a thought partner to ASPCA departments; facilitates collaboration among departments; and connects the dots to maximize efforts to drive our goals forward.


Shelter Animals Count, established in 2012, is dedicated to collecting and sharing reliable shelter data to improve welfare and outcomes for animals and communities. By serving as a neutral, industry\-wide data collection entity, Shelter Animals Count provides valuable insights into shelter operations, trends in animal welfare, intake and outcomes, and the challenges faced by shelters, rescues, and communities. Shelter Animals Count collaborates with organizations of all sizes to encourage data submission, fostering a comprehensive understanding of the state of animal welfare. This data\-driven approach supports evidence\-based decision\-making, ultimately helping to improve welfare and outcomes for animals, guide policy, and increase transparency within the animal welfare community.


**What You’ll Do**


SAC's Research \& Data Science Team works across three core focuses: Analytics \& Insights (answering internal and externals and translating SAC data into reports, dashboards, and stories that describe what is happening in sheltering), Data Quality \& Observability (working closely with our technology systems and data pipelines to ensure the data behind those answers is accurate, stable, and ready for use), and Research, Prediction \& Measurement (causal inference, experimentation, forecasting, and building generalizable knowledge for the animal welfare field). Every member of the team contributes to each focus, with this role centered on the first two.


You will be the subject matter expert for SAC's insights capabilities \- owning the pipeline of data requests from media, partners, researchers, member organizations, and internal teams from intake through delivery, ensuring every request is tracked, scoped, and fulfilled with timely, accurate statistics and clear methodology. Your role will be critical in translating complex datasets into actionable insights that inform national policy, shelter operations, and public awareness. Additionally, you will lead efforts to monitor and improve the quality of SAC's national database and support the improvement of machine learning and of forecasting models led by the Senior Manager, Data Science, and help translate complex datasets into actionable insights that inform national policy, shelter operations, and public awareness. This role involves hands\-on work with Shelter Animals Count's database (for example, frequent analysis of datasets including 20M\+ animals, many parameters) and day\-to\-day ownership of structured intake and project tracking systems. The ideal candidate is exceptionally organized, comfortable owning and prioritizing a high volume of concurrent requests, and rigorous about accuracy, documentation, and reproducibility. They serve as a subject matter expert of animal welfare data and software.


The Senior Data Analyst reports directly to the Senior Manager, Data Science and has 0 direct reports.

This remote\-based position (which requires travel, as described below) is open to all eligible candidates based within the United States. =========================================


Become a part of our caring community and help us put health first
  

  

Humana is evolving how creative and content work is planned, prioritized, scoped, and delivered across the enterprise. As Senior Project Manager, you will help translate complex business needs into clear project plans, timelines, dependencies, and delivery paths that enable teams to create compliant, on\-brand communications for members, patients, caregivers, and communities.
  

  

In a typical day, you may lead project planning discussions, manage creative workflow milestones, align cross\-functional partners, identify risks, support prioritization, and keep stakeholders informed from intake through final delivery.
The Senior Project Manager leads the planning, coordination, and delivery of complex creative and content initiatives that support Humana’s marketing, brand, and customer experience priorities. This role partners with intake \& scoping, creative, account, compliance, technology, and business stakeholders to define scope, manage timelines, resolve dependencies, and maintain delivery visibility. The Senior Project Manager helps teams work efficiently by applying project management discipline, workflow standards, and proactive risk management. This work supports Humana by improving speed, quality, and accountability for communications that help members and patients make informed health decisions.

**Key Role Functions**

* Lead end\-to\-end project planning and execution for complex creative, content, and marketing initiatives, including scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, and delivery expectations
* Partner with the Associate Director, Intake \& Scoping and cross\-functional leaders to evaluate work requests, clarify requirements, prioritize demand, and recommend delivery paths
* Manage project risks, tradeoffs, change requests, and stakeholder communications to keep work moving and reduce delays, rework, and escalation
* Coordinate internal teams, external vendors, and production partners to deliver high\-quality, compliant, on\-brand work across digital, print, email, social, video, and integrated campaign channels
* Identify workflow trends, capacity constraints, and process improvement opportunities that strengthen operational performance and improve member and patient experiences

jobs.title: Principal Business Analyst, Fraud
jobs.description:
Mission Lane is combining the power of data, technology, and exceptional service to pave a clear way forward for millions of people on the path to financial success. By attracting top talent and leveraging cutting\-edge technology, we're enabling people to unlock real financial progress. Sound like a mission you can get behind?


We're looking for a Principal Business Analyst, Fraud to design and test the defenses that stop fraudulent applications, reporting to the Director, Fraud.


**The impact you'll make:**



Right now, someone is filling out an application for their first credit card, hoping it's the start of something they can build on. Fraudsters have learned to mimic that same hope on paper. A thin credit file and a stolen identity can look nearly identical on the surface, and the line between them shifts as fraud tactics evolve. You'll build and test the logic that draws that line, making sure the real applicant gets a fair, fast answer, and the fraudster doesn't get a credit card.



Mission Lane is still young, but we've landed in an exciting, stable stretch of maturation. We're still building but we've already got a solid foundation. There's never been a better time to learn and grow right along with us.


**As Principal Business Analyst, Fraud, you will:**


* Dig into application data to independently identify emerging fraud patterns and surface vulnerabilities before they scale.
* Design, build, and run A/B and Champion/Challenger tests to develop new real\-time defenses against fraudulent applications.
* Balance risk and customer experience by translating test results into thoughtful, data\-backed recommendations.
* Build and maintain dashboards that track defense performance against coverage, applicant friction and abandonment, and losses.
* Partner with Operations, Product, Data Science, and Engineering to continuously sharpen fraud detection capabilities.
* Mentor less experienced analysts on the team as they build their own fraud analytics judgment.


**You'll thrive in this role if:**


* You're comfortable working on an undefined problem. Application fraud data rarely comes with a clean hypothesis attached, and you enjoy framing the question as much as answering it.
* You know how to tell the story behind your analysis, not just report the numbers.
* You take ownership of your conclusions and can defend them under scrutiny, while always staying open to being wrong.


**Minimum qualifications:**


* 2\+ years of experience in a highly analytical role (e.g., risk, business analytics, data science), with the majority of that experience spent working directly with data rather than individual case decisioning.
* Experience conducting analytical work with credit cards or other consumer lending products.
* Hands\-on experience designing and executing A/B or Champion/Challenger testing within an application or risk funnel.
* Proven ability to independently frame an ambiguous question, form a hypothesis, analyze the data, and defend the answer with stakeholders.
* Strong familiarity with SQL, Python, or other tools for data analysis.
* Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Engineering, Mathematics, or a similar quantitative field with a record of strong academic performance.
* Ability to travel \~4\-6\+ times per year for high quality in person collaboration.


**Preferred qualifications:**


* Direct experience in Fraud Strategy and Analytics.
* Expertise in SQL and Python.
* Experience helping scale a business in a fast\-paced startup environment.


**Compensation:**  

Annual full\-time starting base salary range: $118,000\-$135,000\.



This role is eligible for additional compensation in the forms of participation in our annual incentive and equity programs.



Pay is based on factors such as work experience, education, certification(s), training, skills, and competencies related to the role. Mission Lane also offers a comprehensive benefits plan, which includes paid time off, 401(k) match, a monthly wellness stipend, health/dental/vision insurance options, disability coverage, paid parental leave, flexible spending account (for childcare and healthcare), life insurance, and a remote\-first work environment.

  

**About Mission Lane:**



Founded in December 2018, Mission Lane is a purpose\-driven fintech company based in the U.S., with headquarters in Richmond, Virginia.



It all started with a realization: nearly fifty percent of the adult population in the U.S. doesn't have access to a clear line of credit. Most traditional credit card companies either overlook or overcharge this group because they have less\-than\-perfect credit scores or no scores at all. We decided this just wouldn't do.



In partnership with our sponsor banks, we offer credit cards under the Mission Lane brand name, with better, clearer terms, and a more refined customer experience than the alternatives available to people working hard to improve their credit. To date, over four million consumers have chosen Mission Lane, earning high customer ratings on Credit Karma for its market segment and industry leading Net Promoter scores.



Mission Lane has cumulatively raised over $600 million of equity from leading investors, including Invus Opportunities, QED Investors, LL Funds, funds affiliated with Oaktree Capital Management, and other leading investors.



**Our commitment to a workplace built on respect and dignity is guided by our core value of Unity. We believe that everyone plays a vital role in our shared purpose, and we actively cultivate an environment where all individuals have the opportunity to do their best work. By fostering a culture of empathy and collaboration, we create a strong sense of belonging and support for every team member.**



Mission Lane is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex (including pregnancy, sexual orientation, or gender identity), national origin, age, disability, genetic information

**Job Title: Senior Revenue Operations Analyst**


**Location: United States, Remote**



This is a fully remote opportunity and can be worked from any location in the United States.


**ABOUT THE COMPANY:**



Salesloft is building the next era of enterprise revenue — one where teams make confident decisions powered by AI and real signals. By combining our scale, insights, and AI innovation, we're building the industry's first Predictive Revenue System, enabling humans and AI to work together to make smarter decisions and drive consistent growth.



With thousands of customers using our platforms every day, we have an unmatched view into how revenue is actually won — the Revenue Context that reveals what happens, when, and with what outcome. This gives us a unique opportunity to transform an entire category and set a new benchmark for how modern revenue teams operate.



Join us to help transform how companies around the world run revenue — and build the platform that will guide leading revenue teams into the future.


**THE OPPORTUNITY:**



At Salesloft, our Senior Revenue Operations Analyst will be pivotal to our company's success. You'll report to our VP of Revenue Operations and own the recurring, data\-intensive engine that keeps the Revenue Operations function running, from bonus calculations to quota setting to capacity and forecast models, while also taking on ad hoc modeling for our biggest strategic questions. You'll partner closely with our GTM Ops \& AI Transformation and Marketing Ops \& GTM Engineering leadership, and work cross\-functionally with Data \& Analytics, FP\&A, Commissions, HR, and Business Systems. Increasingly, this role will also mean building AI agents in Claude that let the broader Ops team run these analyses themselves: we're looking for someone excited to grow into that part of the job.



On a day\-to\-day basis, you will:


* Lead cross\-functional strategic projects; including structuring business problems, exploring solutions, implementing/refining processes, and measuring impact
* Own quarterly bonus payment calculations and rep quota setting and updates
* Maintain and refine our capacity models, forecast algorithms, and product reporting, working with Data \& Analytics and FP\&A to keep methodology sound as the business changes.
* Own weekly KPI pulls and builds the reporting tools and dashboards that operationalize and socialize key performance metrics for Revenue leadership (e.g. quota attainment, capacity utilization, forecast accuracy).
* Lead ad hoc modeling for high\-visibility initiatives, such as capacity modeling for new CSM engagement models and pricing \& packaging impact analysis and recommendations.
* Identify process improvement and automation opportunities and work with cross\-functional teams to drive implementation and roll out.
* Partner cross\-functionally on key components of our annual planning process, including capacity modeling, target setting, and compensation plan design.
* Build and maintain AI agents in Claude that give the rest of the Ops team self\-serve access to recurring analyses and data, a growing part of this role; prior agent\-building experience is a plus, but genuine curiosity and a willingness to learn matter more.


In addition to working with amazing colleagues who live our core values every day, you will also have the opportunity to shape how a fast\-growing revenue organization plans, pays, and forecasts: and to help pioneer what AI\-assisted revenue operations looks like in practice. You will have an opportunity to make a difference.


**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR:**



We are seeking a bias\-towards\-action, results\-oriented, motivated and strategic operations professional who can collaborate cross\-functional while remaining laser\-focused on impacting our revenue numbers. Specifically, you will play a pivotal role in helping us scale in this next phase of rapid growth as a revenue organization.



If you're looking for an opportunity to learn more, do more, and become more, then becoming a Senior Revenue Operations Analyst is the career path for you!


**THE TEAM:**



Our Salesloft Revenue Operations team is comprised of seasoned and up\-and\-coming operations, business, and data analysts.



Values: Move as One, Evidence over Ego, Lead from the Front, Make Your Mark, Customer\-Inspired.



The Revenue Operations team consists of operations, business, and data analysts with a drive to enable Salesloft to make better decisions. Our team shares a few common traits: they are accountable, unafraid to experiment, and continuously learning.


**THE SKILL SET:**


* 4\+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Business/Data Analytics, or another relevant quantitative field
* Looker/Tableau (data visualization) experience preferred
* Advanced Excel/Google Sheets modeling skills: able to build and maintain complex, error\-resistant spreadsheet models independently; SQL is a nice\-to\-have, not required, given our Snowflake agents handle most ad hoc data access
* Track record of using data to transform business processes
* Excellent interpersonal skills; ability to work well with and communicate to all levels of Revenue team and also C\-level executives
* Experience building or using AI agents/tools (e.g. Claude) to automate recurring analyses is a plus, but not required; genuine curiosity and a willingness to learn matter more
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to distill complex ideas and analytics so they are understandable to revenue leadership
* Must be a self\-starter, creative, high energy, and comfortable running an initiative in a start\-up paced software company

jobs.description:
Significance, Inc is seeking a Senior Management Business Analyst to support an upcoming federal program (contingent upon award). This position is primarily remote, with occasional onsite support at the Department of Labor (DOL) office in Washington, DC, as needed. This position requires the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust.

The U.S. Department of Labor keeps its books in the New Core Financial Management System (NCFMS), an Oracle E\-Business Suite platform used by about 1,600 people to move roughly $70 billion a year. You will be the senior functional link between DOL accountants and the people who build and fix the system. You will own requirements, testing, and the hardest production problems in Federal Financials. When the general ledger does not tie out at year\-end, that lands with you.

Objective: keep NCFMS functionally correct and audit\-ready, so that DOL's accounting operations close on time and every configuration, interface, and enhancement change holds up under Treasury, OMB, GAO, and financial statement audit scrutiny.
### **Required Skills:**


Minimum 9 years of professional experience as a Business Analyst, Functional Analyst, or ERP business systems analyst supporting enterprise financial management systems. Federal financial systems experience strongly preferred within that total.  

* Minimum 5 of those 9 years hands\-on functional experience with Oracle E\-Business Suite Federal Financials in one or more of: General Ledger, Accounts Payable, Accounts Receivable, Fixed Assets, Sub Ledger Accounting, Budget Execution, Purchase Cards, and Oracle Projects.
* Functional business process analysis for a federal ERP system, spanning each aspect of both traditional and Agile SDLCs \- requirements through design, test, deployment, and post\-production support.
* Demonstrated experience eliciting, analyzing, and documenting business and functional requirements; authoring functional design documents, use cases, and process flows; maintaining requirements traceability; and validating that requirements were correctly implemented.
* Test planning and execution: developing test scenarios, scripts, and traceability matrices; executing unit, system, integration, regression, and User Acceptance Testing; documenting results and driving defects to closure.
* Production support and complex issue resolution: triaging user\-reported issues, root\-cause analysis, researching transaction and posting\-logic errors, and coordinating resolution with technical, DBA, and security teams \- including Tier 2 and Tier 3 functional support.
* Authoring senior\-level analytical deliverables: analysis papers, analyses of alternatives, decision papers, and other project deliverables for Government review.
* Performing quality assurance and oversight of functional work products \- peer review of requirements, design, and test artifacts.
* Working knowledge of federal financial management compliance drivers: U.S. Standard General Ledger (USSGL), Treasury Financial Manual, FASAB standards, OMB circulars, GAO guidance, budget execution and funds control, and the Anti\-Deficiency Act.
* Experience with structured change control and Change Control Board processes.
* Experience managing assigned work in an industry\-standard issue and backlog management tool
* Ability to perform with limited supervision and to provide direction, review, or mentoring to less senior analysts
### **Desired Skills:**

* Prior experience supporting federal Core Financial System with Oracle Federal Financials at a CFO Act agency
* Experience with end\-to\-end business processes: Procure\-to\-Pay, Bill\-to\-Collect, Acquire\-to\-Dispose, Request\-to\-Procure, Budget Execution, Purchase Cards, Grants Management, Unemployment Trust Fund, Travel Management, General Ledger Integrity, and Working Capital Fund cost allocation using Oracle Projects.
* Experience with Treasury G\-Invoicing, including 7600A Interagency Agreements and 7600B Orders; GTAS; DATA Act reporting; and the Treasury Report on Receivables.
* Experience with applications and interfaces such as: Tungsten MarkView / Capture invoice imaging and workflow, Oracle Analytics Server reporting, Invoice Processing Platform, SAM vendor data, ETS2 travel, HHS GrantSolutions, NFC payroll, the AMS real\-time requisition and award interface, and the Citibank Purchase Card interface.
* Experience supporting federal financial statement audits — researching transactions, preparing audit responses and supporting documentation, and remediating findings through corrective action plans.
* Experience writing knowledge\-base articles, standard operating procedures, quick reference guides, and user job aids.
* Experience as a task lead or supervising junior functional analysts on a federal ERP O\&M engagement.

These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

jobs.description:
CoreWeave is The Essential Cloud for AI™. Built for pioneers by pioneers, CoreWeave delivers a platform of technology, tools, and teams that enables innovators to build and scale AI with confidence. Trusted by leading AI labs, startups, and global enterprises, CoreWeave combines superior infrastructure performance with deep technical expertise to accelerate breakthroughs and turn compute into capability. Founded in 2017, CoreWeave became a publicly traded company (Nasdaq: CRWV) in March 2025\. Learn more at www.coreweave.com.
**What You'll Do**
------------------



We are seeking an experienced and highly motivated Sr. Infrastructure Capacity Program Manager, NPI to join our Infrastructure Capacity team. In this role, you will be the go\-to infrastructure capacity partner for our Hardware New Product Introduction (NPI) and Engineering Operations teams — tracking data center infrastructure hardware roadmaps, determining ordering cut\-over points, and signaling scope and BOM requirements to Capacity, Supply Chain, Construction, and Execution so that new hardware programs land in the fleet on schedule and old hardware is retired cleanly.


**About the role**
------------------


***Core Responsibilities***


* **NPI Roadmap:** Track infrastructure hardware NPI roadmaps and transition schedules across power, cooling, and network, giving Infrastructure Capacity forward visibility into what's coming online and what's being retired.
* **Cut\-Over Point Determination:** Determine the cut\-over point between ordering legacy/outgoing hardware and new/incoming hardware for each site or program — weighing lead times, EOL risk, and deployment timing to avoid over\-ordering hardware that's about to be replaced or under\-ordering ahead of a delayed transition.
* **Downstream Signaling (Scope \& BOM):** Signal downstream teams — Capacity, Supply Chain, Construction, and the Execution team — with clear scope and Bill of Materials (BOM) requirements as new hardware programs take shape, so each team can plan, budget, and procure in lockstep rather than reacting late.
* **NPI Weekly Meeting Representation:** Attend NPI weekly DC planning meetings as the standing representative of the Infrastructure Capacity team — bringing a capacity and infrastructure\-readiness lens into hardware planning discussions, and carrying decisions, risks, and action items back to Infrastructure Capacity and affected downstream teams.
* **Infrastructure Readiness PM \& Ownership:** Act as the program manager for infrastructure readiness on NPI hardware programs — driving cross\-functional workstreams, tracking milestones and risks, and ensuring power, cooling, network, and space readiness are in place ahead of each program's target ship/deployment date.


***Additional Responsibilities***


* **Infrastructure DC NPI / Product Scaling Designs:** Partner with Hardware NPI teams to translate new GPU/CPU, power, and cooling product designs into data center infrastructure requirements at scale — assessing whether existing site designs (power density, cooling architecture, rack/row layout) can support a new product generation, and defining the infrastructure scaling design changes needed where they cannot.
* **Cooling \& Power Architecture Transition Planning:** Apply working technical knowledge of cooling and power infrastructure to plan for major architecture transitions as new hardware programs mature — for example, moves from air\-cooled (AC) racks to in\-rack Coolant Distribution Units (CDUs) to fully remote/centralized CDU plants — translating each transition into concrete power, space, and facility impacts for Design, Capacity, Supply Chain, and Construction.
* **Rack \& Network Hardware Program Support:** Provide infrastructure\-readiness planning for new rack\-level power/cooling control hardware (e.g., rack\-level power and cooling controller/monitoring modules and liquid\-cooling valve and manifold assemblies) and new high\-density, liquid\-cooled networking/switch rack designs, ensuring power, cooling, space, and cabling\-pathway readiness keeps pace with these programs from early prototype/pilot stages through fleet\-wide rollout.
* **Vendor \& Cross\-Functional Collaboration:** Partner with Hardware NPI teams, equipment OEMs, DC Design and Network Engineering, Supply Chain, and Construction to align NPI timelines with site plans, procurement lead times, and CapEx/OpEx budgeting.
* **Technical Documentation:** Maintain accurate and comprehensive documentation of NPI roadmaps, EOL schedules, cut\-over decisions, scope/BOM handoffs, and lifecycle\-management decisions, ensuring a clear system of record as hardware generations turn over.
* **Problem Solving:** Identify and resolve complex planning challenges where new hardware requirements outpace existing site capabilities, or where cut\-over timing is at risk, escalating trade\-offs that affect delivery timelines.
* **Industry Trends:** Stay abreast of emerging compute, power, cooling, and network hardware roadmaps and industry NPI/lifecycle\-management best practices, incorporating relevant advancements into CoreWeave's own NPI planning process.

**Who You Are**
---------------


* Data center infrastructure technical knowledge to understand and engage credibly in discussions about the products involved — GPUs, CPUs, Coolant Distribution Units (CDUs), power hardware chain, and cooling infrastructure — without needing to design the hardware yourself.
* Strong program/project management skills: able to drive cross\-functional workstreams, track milestones and risks, hold multiple teams accountable to dates, and keep several concurrent NPI programs moving in parallel.

jobs.description:
Comunilife Inc., Real Estate Property Management department is looking for an experienced Property Management Data Analyst to join its team. The Data Analyst supports the management and operations of one or more affordable and supportive housing properties. Reporting to the Director of Property Management, this role is responsible for data entry and management, ensuring accurate and timely data is reflected in comprehensive and clear reporting, analyzing performance, and serving as the subject matter expert for the organization’s property management software system (RealPage).

  

The Data Analyst is essential to efficient and effective execution of property management functions in alignment with regulatory requirements and organizational standards and plays a key role in supporting strong operational performance while advancing the organization’s mission to provide high\-quality, stable housing to underserved communities.




**Essential Duties:**

**Data Management**

* Input information into property management software system (RealPage) as required to keep records up to date.•
* Maintain accurate, complete, timely and audit\-ready tenant and property data within property management software system (RealPage), including tenant accounts, posted payments, tenant ledgers, balances, rent rolls and other property\-related information as needed.

Conduct data audits, reconcile and address issues.  
* 

**Reporting**

* Prepare reports using property management software system (RealPage) to analyze performance of the portfolio.
* Prepare property rental, operational, and compliance reports and support submission of required documentation to internal and external stakeholders including Board, funders and investors.
* Support preparation of documentation for audits, financial reporting, and regulatory compliance.
* Ensure reporting meets requirements for owners, lenders, investors, and regulatory agencies.

**Analysis**

* Review weekly, monthly, and quarterly reports on occupancy, collections, and operations.
* Track key performance metrics and indicators including occupancy, leasing trends, collections, and compliance metrics.
* Analyze portfolio operational performance, identify operational issues that require action, and escalate performance concerns.
* Provide input on strategies and solutions to improve financial performance and operational outcomes.
* Recommend best practice solutions and strategies for improvement in areas identified.
* Support legal and compliance processes related to rent and recertification, tax credit, bond, and other regulatory requirements.
* Assist with file reviews, audits, and tracking of compliance deadlines.

Assist in managing tenant and subsidy payments and documentation.  
* 

**Software System Management (RealPage)**

* Serve as subject matter expert for property management software system (RealPage).•
* Evaluate existing and ongoing updates to software system functionality and provide recommendations to improve operational performance and address organizational needs.
* Participate in RealPage implementation efforts.
* Ensure ongoing system integrity.
* Train and support staff on RealPage functionality and reporting.

**Education and Experience Requirement(s):**  

Bachelor’s degree with at least 2 years of data management experience is required.  

Experience with RealPage or similar property management systems is required.

Leidos is seeking an experienced Project Manager to support the Indo\-Pacific Logistics and Sustainment Services (ILS2\) program in Aiea, HI. RCG is seeking an experienced **Agency Program Manager** to lead complex programs supporting civilian federal government customers.


This key leadership role has overall responsibility for **contract performance, delivery, financial management, staffing, compliance, and customer relationships**. The Program Manager will serve as the primary liaison between RCG and government stakeholders, ensuring program activities align with agency objectives, contractual requirements, schedules, and budgets.


The ideal candidate is an experienced federal program leader with a strong understanding of both **contract delivery and business operations**.

**What You’ll Do**

**Program \& Contract Management**

* Provide overall leadership and accountability for complex federal contracts, task orders, and related workstreams.
* Establish program objectives, priorities, schedules, and performance expectations.
* Develop and maintain **Program Management Plans, Work Breakdown Structures (WBS), schedules, and risk registers**.
* Ensure contract deliverables meet quality, schedule, performance, and customer requirements.
* Maintain compliance with contract terms, **Federal Acquisition Regulation (FAR)** requirements, agency policies, and applicable governance standards.

jobs.title: Program Manager, MC2
jobs.description:
**Program Manager, MC2**



Based in Washington, DC

  

The AFL\-CIO Working for America Institute (WAI) is a non\-profit, 501(c) (3\) national workforce development organization for the labor movement. WAI assists unions, employers, labor\-management partnerships, the workforce system, and community organizations by providing technical assistance, education, leadership development and policy analysis. WAI implements employment, apprenticeship, and training\-related services that help to create, expand, and retain high quality jobs.



WAI is seeking to hire a Program Manager who will work with the executive director and deputy director to implement and manage the deployment, national growth, and ongoing updating and improvement of the MC2 (Manufacturing Core Curriculum), a high quality pre\-hire/pre\-apprenticeship training curriculum to prepare workers for careers and apprenticeships in the manufacturing sector. The Program Manager will also work with local partners to implement associated training programs that utilize the MC2 curriculum. The Program Manager will lead program strategy and implementation, including achieving initial deployment/ utilization of MC2 and national expansion, developing workplans, ensuring the project meets workplan, performance, and other objectives and supporting fundraising efforts.



The position is based in Washington, D.C. and reports to the Deputy Director. Our hybrid schedule allows up to two days per week of remote work.

 **Description**  

*Project Leadership and Strategy*


* Lead the strategy and implementation of the project, which is a new universal pre\-apprenticeship/career and technical education curriculum to prepare workers for manufacturing entry\-level jobs and is at the early stage of implementation.
* Manage and oversee local deployment of associated high\-quality training utilizing the MC2
* Ensure that funds are used in accordance with the terms and conditions of grants


*Project Implementation*


* Work with the Deputy Director and project partners to develop and implement project strategies, goals, and objectives, including identifying promising local partners to utilize MC2, supporting development of their MC2 programs through technical assistance
* Oversee licensing of the MC2 curriculum and revenue generation.
* Develop and oversee short, medium, and long\-term workplans for several phases of work – including adoption, implementation, scaling, and maintenance– to ensure that activities, outcomes, and deliverables are achieved and meet required timelines.
* Develop promising practices to deliver strong project outcomes and gather models of best practices for replication and expansion.
* Lead updates to and maintenance of the curriculum.


*Partner management*


* In collaboration with the executive director and deputy director, establish and maintain strategic partnerships and relationships with senior\-level representatives of unions, employers, training providers, government officials, philanthropy organizations, and others.
* Coordinate and lead meetings and communications with partners


*Communications and administrative oversight*


* In conjunction with the Executive Director and Deputy Director, hire and manage a team of project support staff, consultants, and contractors
* Identify opportunities to communicate project successes.
* Support project communications strategies and contribute to external communications, including outreach materials, website content, and materials and information for funders, the Board of Directors, and key stakeholders.
* Develop and track project budgets and expenditures and assist the Deputy Director in reviewing and managing the budgets.
* Oversee organization and maintenance of project files.


*Fundraising and supporting WAI growth and operations*


* Identify opportunities to leverage resources to meet project objectives.
* Support and, upon request, lead on fundraising for MC2 programming, including maintaining or building funder relationships, writing persuasive project narratives to support funding requests, grant applications,and project budgets, and identifying new funding opportunities.
* Assist WAI staff in establishing annual planning and budgeting priorities to advance WAI’s goals.
* Participate in WAI meetings and prepare written and oral reports as required.
* Work with the Director of Finance and Operations to prepare and submit financial, budget and project reports required by funders.
* Contribute to development opportunities, grant applications, and funding proposals.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

  


**Knowledge and Skill Requirements**


* Five or more years of project management experience, preferably in a labor\-related organization.
* Knowledge of or experience in workforce development and/or curriculum development preferred.
* Demonstrated experience in the manufacturing sector strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated experience working with union training programs; labor\-management workforce intermediaries; and/or collectively bargained training programs strongly preferred.
* Demonstrated knowledge of the structure and operations of the AFL\-CIO, state and local labor federations, and international/national unions preferred.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently within the context of a plan, to foster strong lateral partnerships as part of a larger team, and to work in both a lead and a support role, aligning with supervisory guidance and the chain of command
* Computer proficiency is required: database, spreadsheet, e\-mail, internet and word processing skills, including Google Suite.
* Effective time management skills, including prioritizing and managing multiple tasks, project planning and implementation, and demonstrated experience in developing personal work plans and goals.
* Excellent organizational skills, attention to detail, and follow\-through on assignments
* Strong written and oral communication skills.
* Ability to travel and stay

jobs.title: Project Manager/Scrum Master
jobs.description:
Overview:

Steampunk is seeking a **Project Manager** who is creative and is a hands\-on expert with delivering innovative technology solutions.  

Responsibilities will include team leadership for the complete life cycle of solution development and delivery, providing Agile Project Management support and Scrum Master support for Agile teams, coordinating with product owners and stakeholders on prioritizing the backlog, creating release schedules and roadmaps based on assessment recommendations, and establishing technical practices and release management standards that align with the customer's process. This individual will also ensure the team is following, and effective at, Agile scrum processes as well as driving high client satisfaction.  


Contributions:

As a **Project Manager**, you will be leading the project tasking and delivery in a government client consulting environment. You will be a client liaison, team coach, and mentor.

  

* Manage and maintain successful/results\-oriented relationships with the client, as well as identify and pursue new opportunities with existing client.
* Develop and drive high\-level strategic initiatives, manage remote project delivery team, and possess the ability to facilitate technical discussions to troubleshoot project implementation issues.
* Assess the current organization and delivery environment and recommend optimal Agile practices tailored to the client.
* Provide the Agile Scrum Master support. Attend Agile ceremonies and provide input as needed.
* Remove blockers to ensure project success.
* Coach the Product Owner and team on backlog refinement and prioritization.
* Handle challenging client situations and offer technical and business guidance and direction to client executives.
* Lead and manage staff, monitor staff performance.
* Evaluate project feasibility, eliminate non\-productive tasking, and find creative ways to ensure project delivery and if feasible accelerate delivery.
* Assist staff with training needs to create skills expansion and career advancement opportunities.

  


Qualifications:
* Ability to obtain a U.S. government Public Trust Security Clearance
* Bachelor’s degree and 8\+ years of experience
* 5\+ years managing IT projects using agile methodologies and approaches
* 5\+ year experience with Scrum/Kanban Methodologies
* Ability to establish immediate credibility with clients, build consensus, and achieve goals through influence
* Flexibility to work with teams, individuals, and executives and willingness to help with a wide variety of work products and people
* Excellent interpersonal and communication skills
* Experience working in a complex engineering environment

**Preferred*** Experience working in a studio / human centered design approach
* PMP and Scrum Master certification

  


About **steampunk**:

Steampunk relies on several factors to determine salary, including but not limited to geographic location, contractual requirements, education, knowledge, skills, competencies, and experience. The projected compensation range for this position is $110,000 to $175,000\. The estimate displayed represents a typical annual salary range for this position. Annual salary is just one aspect of Steampunk’s total compensation package for employees. Learn more about additional Steampunk benefits here. **Identity Statement**
As part of the application process, you are expected to be on camera during interviews and assessments. We reserve the right to take your picture to verify your identity and prevent fraud.  

Steampunk is a **Change Agent** in the Federal contracting industry, bringing new thinking to clients in the Homeland, Federal Civilian, Health and DoD sectors. Through our **Human\-Centered delivery methodology**, we are fundamentally changing the expectations our Federal clients have for true shared accountability in solving their toughest mission challenges. If you want to learn more about our story, visit http://www.steampunk.com. *We are an equal opportunity employer and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, disability status, protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by law. Steampunk participates in the E\-Verify program.*

jobs.description:
**Job description**
===================

**Senior Program Manager, Professional Services**

**Location:** DC/MD/VA Remote
  

**Clearance:** Active Top Secret / Sensitive Compartmented Information **(TS/SCI)** Security Clearance required
  

**Certification:** PMP Required


**POSITION OVERVIEW:**

Hitachi Federal is seeking an experienced **Senior Program Manager Professional Services** to lead the successful delivery, growth, and performance of a portfolio of complex federal technology engagements.


This role serves as a senior customer and delivery leader, with accountability for **customer satisfaction, program performance, financial management, resource planning, team development, and organic growth** across assigned engagements. The Senior Program Manager will partner across Professional Services, Sales, Finance, Contracts, Human Resources, and technical teams to ensure engagements are delivered successfully while identifying opportunities to expand our support of federal customers.


The ideal candidate is a PMP\-certified leader with deep experience managing complex federal IT programs involving software development, cloud, data, and infrastructure technologies. This individual combines disciplined program management with strong business acumen, executive\-level customer engagement, technical understanding, and a growth mindset.


This is a highly visible role for a leader who can manage the details of successful program execution while maintaining a broader view of customer needs, portfolio performance, and business growth.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Program \& Portfolio Leadership**

* Own the overall health and performance of an assigned portfolio of professional services engagements, including **delivery, schedule, financial performance, staffing, customer satisfaction, risk, and growth** .
* Serve as the primary Hitachi Federal program management point of contact with customers, prime contractors, partners, and other key stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customer stakeholders and executive leadership.
* Implement and coordinate service delivery across assigned programs to ensure execution against clearly defined scope, schedule, budget, and customer requirements.
* Maintain accountability for all program requirements, including technical delivery, budget, schedule, staffing, growth, contractual commitments, and overall performance.
* Establish and monitor appropriate program and portfolio KPIs, including schedule, budget, utilization, margin, customer satisfaction, and delivery performance.
* Proactively identify, manage, mitigate, and communicate program issues, risks, dependencies, and potential impacts.
* Manage resources across multiple projects and maintain visibility into staffing requirements, utilization, deliverables, schedules, and budgets.
* Conduct readiness reviews to ensure appropriate technical resources and administrative support are in place prior to project start dates.
* Participate in and lead monthly program management reviews, providing clear visibility into technical, financial, schedule, growth, risk, and performance metrics.
* Establish and enforce appropriate work standards and delivery practices to drive consistency, quality, accountability, and customer satisfaction.

**Customer \& Stakeholder Leadership**

* Establish trusted relationships with federal customers, prime contractors, partners, and internal stakeholders.
* Lead executive\-level customer governance, including program reviews, escalations, performance discussions, and strategic planning.
* Understand customer business and mission requirements and translate those needs into actionable technology and professional services solutions.
* Apply knowledge of industry trends and technologies across areas such as **infrastructure, cloud services, operations, data management and protection, data intelligence, data analytics, virtualization, and applications** .
* Ensure conformity with contractual obligations while maintaining appropriate technical and financial reporting to demonstrate program progress and performance.
* Coordinate project\-related activities across Hitachi Federal functions, including Professional Services, Sales, Solutions, Finance, Contracts, Staffing, and Human Resources.
* Communicate proactively and effectively with business, technical, customer, and executive stakeholders at all levels.

**Financial \& Operational Management**

* Own the financial health of assigned engagements in partnership with Finance, including **revenue forecasting, margin performance, labor utilization, invoicing, budget management, and variance analysis** .
* Reconcile actual labor hours and costs against project budgets and forecasts.
* Work closely with Finance to ensure accurate time reporting, invoicing, revenue forecasting, and financial visibility.
* Manage subcontractor performance and ensure alignment with contractual requirements, delivery expectations, and program objectives.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive cost, schedule, performance, and risk reporting.
* Identify opportunities to improve delivery processes, eliminate duplication, increase accuracy, and create greater efficiency and scalability across Professional Services.
* Develop and maintain Statements of Work, Work Breakdown Structures, project plans, schedules, and other program documentation necessary for successful execution.

**Growth \& Business Development**

* Proactively identify opportunities for **contract extensions, follow\-on work, scope expansion, recompetes, and new professional services engagements** within existing customer relationships.
* Understand evolving customer challenges and identify opportunities that may be addressed through Hitachi technologies, solutions, or professional services.
* Communicate identified growth opportunities to Sales, Capture, Contracts, Professional Services, and senior leadership and support their transition into the growth pipeline.

jobs.title: Cyber Threat Operations Program Manager
jobs.description:
*By joining the National Student Clearinghouse, you can be sure that the work you do now will help shape the future of education and the workforce in the U.S. As the trusted source for higher education data since 1993, the Clearinghouse is the leading provider of transcript and data exchange services, automated enrollment and degree verifications, learner insights and research, and compliance solutions for schools, businesses, and learners nationwide. As a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit organization, the Clearinghouse works with nearly 3,600 postsecondary institutions to meet their compliance needs and with thousands of high schools and districts to provide continuing collegiate enrollment, progression, and completion statistics about their alumni. In addition, the Research Center publications inform policymakers and business leaders about student educational pathways. Using our unique combination of data, analytics, and software to drive our mission, security and privacy is paramount. Join us as we continue to invest in our talent and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data on behalf of all learners.*

**About the Role:**
-------------------


The Technical Specialist, Threat Operations serves as a senior operational leader and key partner within the Cyber Operations team, acting as the functional second\-in\-command across threat operations activities. This role is responsible for building, scaling, and sustaining a comprehensive threat operations program that translates threat and exposure signals into actionable insights and business risk decisions.


This position combines hands\-on operational oversight—including detection, triage, investigation, and response—with ownership of strategic program elements such as threat intelligence, lifecycle governance, and Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The role also requires leadership through influence, driving consistent execution, talent development, and high\-quality outcomes across analysts, partners, and stakeholders.


The Technical Specialist, Threat Operations is expected to maximize AI\-assisted and agentic AI workflows while maintaining human accountability, secure data handling, and audit\-ready evidence. All outputs must remain defensible, traceable, and aligned with enterprise governance standards.


Currently, this is a remote\-first position, and this position may be required to periodically work on\-site at our office and the frequency would depend on the department/division's requirements. Therefore, candidates must either reside within a reasonable distance to commute to our office or be willing to travel to our office in Herndon, when required.


**How You Contribute:**
-----------------------


* Demonstrate the Clearinghouse's core competencies: Customer Focus, Optimizes Work Processes, Collaborates, Communicates Effectively, and Be Open and Authentic.
* Oversee detection, triage, and validation of security alerts, ensuring timely and evidence\-based disposition.
* Translate technical findings into clear risk\-based recommendations and actionable next steps.
* Serve as escalation lead during high\-severity incidents, ensuring proper scoping, documentation, and remediation to closure.
* Develop and mature the threat operations program roadmap, including CTEM strategy and operating model.
* Perform business\-centric threat modeling to align adversary activity with enterprise risk and impact.
* Define governance frameworks, including prioritization logic, escalation criteria, and executive reporting.
* Design and continuously improve repeatable workflows, including AI\-assisted triage, investigation, and reporting processes.
* Establish and manage key performance indicators (e.g., MTTD, MTTR, detection quality, noise reduction).
* Maintain playbooks, investigation templates, and escalation workflows to ensure consistency and audit readiness.
* Drive continuous improvement of detection fidelity through tuning and feedback loops.
* Implement AI\-assisted workflows with clear human\-in\-the\-loop validation and decision points.
* Ensure secure handling of sensitive data and alignment with enterprise AI governance policies.
* Validate AI outputs for accuracy and reliability and mitigate known risks such as hallucinations, bias, or incomplete context.
* Harden AI processes against adversarial threats (e.g., prompt injection, data leakage).
* Lead the threat intelligence lifecycle, including requirements, collection, analysis, dissemination, and feedback.
* Translate intelligence into actionable outputs such as threat hunts, detection priorities, and control validation.
* Deliver executive\-ready threat assessments with clear sourcing and confidence levels.
* Establish operating rhythms and performance expectations with external security partners.
* Ensure alignment with MITRE ATT\&CK coverage and measurable detection and response outcomes.
* Integrate partner outputs into internal workflows, ensuring accountability and closure of findings.
* Lead investigations involving cloud control plane threats (such as AWS and OCI), focusing on identity and configuration risks.
* Correlate cloud, endpoint, identity, and network signals to prioritize remediation based on risk.
* Partner with engineering teams to validate remediation and risk acceptance actions and decisions.
* Coordinate with incident response, engineering, and business stakeholders to drive remediation.
* Integrate third\-party risk insights into threat analysis and recommendations.
* Partner with architecture and assurance teams to improve long\-term security controls.

--------------------------------

**What You’ll Do:**  

You will own the connective tissue between the customer and the delivery team: eliciting and documenting high\-quality requirements, guiding customer stakeholders to the right decisions, translating business needs into buildable specifications, and leading User Acceptance Testing through to sign\-off. * Support delivery of AWS\-hosted applications, cloud services, integrations, and Python\-based solutions.
* Oversee release planning, operational readiness, deployment activities, and transition to support teams.
* Monitor program health through dashboards, status reports, KPIs, and executive briefings.
* Facilitate governance reviews, planning sessions, stakeholder meetings, and decision\-making forums.
* Foster collaboration, accountability, and continuous improvement across Federal, contractor, and vendor teams.

* U.S. Citizenship or Green Card status is required.
* Must be able to OBTAIN and MAINTAIN a Federal or DoD "PUBLIC TRUST"; candidates must obtain approved adjudication of their PUBLIC TRUST prior to onboarding with Guidehouse. Candidates with an ACTIVE PUBLIC TRUST or SUITABILITY are preferred.

* Minimum of FIVE (5\)\+ years of overall work experience.
* Experience managing large\-scale technology programs or projects.
* Experience delivering software development, cloud, systems integration, cybersecurity, infrastructure, or enterprise technology initiatives.
* Strong knowledge of program and project management disciplines, including scope, schedule, cost, risk, quality, change, and stakeholder management.
* Experience leading Agile, Scrum, Kanban, hybrid, or traditional delivery teams.
* Working knowledge of software development lifecycles, cloud environments, cybersecurity, testing, release management, and operational readiness.
* Familiarity with AWS cloud environments and Python\-based applications.
* Ability to understand technical architectures, integrations, security requirements, and delivery dependencies.
* Experience developing governance processes, dashboards, metrics, and executive reporting.
* Strong communication, problem\-solving, facilitation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Project, Jira, Confluence, SharePoint, Microsoft 365, and reporting tools.

* Experience supporting Federal government or highly regulated technology programs.

jobs.title: SCIF_SAPF Project Manager
jobs.description:
The Mission Concepts and Capabilities (MCC) Division of Applied Research Associates, Inc. (ARA) has an exciting opportunity for a full\-time S**ensitive Compartmented Information Facilities (SCIFs) and Special Access Program (SAPF) Facilities Project Manager** at a location in the Arlington or Falls Church, VA area. The potential candidate will provide support to the Office of the Assistant Secretary of War for Nuclear Deterrence, Chemical, and Biological Defense, Policy and Programs by supporting the strategic planning, design, physical and technical security implementation, accreditation lifecycle, ongoing security management, and ultimate turnover of all secure spaces across the enterprise.


**Essential Functions:**


* Project\-Level SCIF Accreditation \& Security Governance by establishing the security architecture and compliance baseline across the entire facility portfolio, ensuring that all physical, technical, and operational security requirements remain intact from design through lifecycle management.
* Secure Facility Operations \& Lifetime SCIF Management overseeing activities beyond initial accreditation through continuous oversight of the accredited spaces and maintaining their security integrity.
* Portfolio \& Project Management by managing the strategic execution, integration, and risk profiles of multiple concurrent secure\-space initiatives.
* Technical Infrastructure \& Network Security Architecture by possessing technical literacy to oversee the complex engineering systems required for accredited secure environments.
* Government Contracting \& Stakeholder Integration by operating within a complex, highly regulated defense environment, acting as the central interface between multiple government and corporate entities.

**Required Skills:**


* Bachelor’s degree in Engineering, Construction Management, Architecture, Facilities Management, Project Management, or a related technical discipline (equivalent experience may be substituted).Applicants must hold an active Top Secret security clearance with SCI eligibility to apply for this position
* Applicant must be a U.S. citizen
* 10\+ years of progressively responsible experience in Project management, secure construction, facilities management, or technical systems rollout.
* 5\+ years of direct experience leading the construction, build\-out, technical security integration, and accreditation lifecycle of SCIFs or SAPFs under ICD 705 standards.
* Proven experience managing multi\-site, multi\-project portfolios with combined budgets exceeding $10M\+.
* Experience working within active accredited SCIF/SAPF spaces, with a deep understanding of compartmented access, "need\-to\-know" protocols, and the strict physical separation of classified operations.

**Preferred Skills:**


* Project Management Professional (PMP) or Program Management Professional (PgMP).
* Relevant DoW, Defense Counterintelligence and Security Agency, or Joint Air Force\-Army\-Navy facility security training.
* Certified Facility Manager or equivalent.
* Technical certifications in networking or secure infrastructure (e.g., CompTIA Security\+, Network\+, or ITIL).

  

**Compensation \& Benefits:** Pay Ranges: From $180,000\.00 \- $190,000\.00 per year based on years of experience, degree and any special skills and knowledge that you may bring to the position. We mostly reserve the upper half of our compensation bands for internal growth. During all call with one of our recruiters or hiring managers, they can further clarify the salary range and total compensation. ARA offers competitive benefits that address our employees’ needs now and in the future. Learn more about each of our benefits at https://www.ara.com/benefits/


**COMPANY INFORMATION:**


Applied Research Associates, Inc. is an employee\-owned international research and engineering company recognized for providing technically superior solutions to complex and challenging problems in the physical sciences. The company, founded in Albuquerque, NM, in 1979, currently employs over 2000 professionals. ARA offices throughout the United States and Canada provide a broad range of technical expertise in defense technologies, civil technologies, computer software and simulation, systems analysis, environmental technologies, and testing and measurement. The corporation also provides sophisticated technical products for environmental site characterization, pavement analysis, and robotics.


At ARA, employees are our greatest assets. The corporation realizes that employee ownership generates greater creativity and initiative along with higher performance and customer satisfaction levels. ARA gives its employees the tools, training, and opportunities to take more active roles as owners. The culture is challenging; innovation and experimentation are the norm. Employees are eligible for contributions which not only add to the company’s success, but also their own through the Employee Stock Ownership Plan (ESOP). The motto, “Engineering and Science for Fun and Profit” sums up the ARA experience. For additional information and an opportunity to join this unique workplace, please visit our website at www.ara.com.


Please apply at www.careers.ara.com for the **SCIF\_SAPF Project Manager** position.

Required
* 10 \- 12 years: Experience in Project Management and lifecycle of SCIF's.

#### **Education**


Required
* Bachelors or better in Engineering or related field

jobs.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon is looking for a Senior Trade Compliance Program Manager (PM) to build import and export risk management solutions for growing international businesses in the Trade Operations space. The Senior Trade Compliance PM, is responsible for managing the strategy of a complex cross\-functional risk program independently.  

  

As a leader within the Global Trade Services team, you will help develop and hire team capabilities, as well as mentor and train colleagues. You will manage the Trade Operations Program team, that works directly with internal teams from legal, logistics, supply chain, quality, engineering, as well as Amazon's global network of trade and compliance teams.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Set processes for Broker Management activities and liaise with brokers and other participants in the supply chain on a daily basis.  

Act as the main point of contact for regulators across the Trade space in North America.  

Set objectives, and drive improvements to your space and quantify with metrics.  

Partner with internal and external stakeholders including business teams, tech teams, public policy, trade, legal, and regulators to interpret and apply regulations.  

Oversee the rollout of controls and audits, including testing and measuring their effectiveness.  

Build flexible and scalable solutions across various customized technologies, business models/supply chain arcs, and country regulatory regimes.  

Stay informed on regulations and technologies relevant to your space and bring them into your risk management programs.  

Present organized plans to articulate the problem statement, the recommended solution, and milestones.  

Identify timelines and owners, and drive progress at the appropriate speed to reduce risk.  

Drive alignment by providing near and long term considerations and impacts, and highlight recommended trade\-offs and priorities.  

Drive the best way forward and build consensus when confronted with discordant views.  

Test assumptions by getting feedback from the right input providers across the company, and review metrics and benchmarks.  

Work with business intelligence engineers and technology teams to design, build and track key performance indicators and systems.  

Communicate risks, proposals, regulatory updates and strategies to internal and external stakeholders in meetings and documents.  

  

A day in the life  

As a Program Manager, you will manage escalations and meet with multiple stakeholders across different time zones to move business forward.  

  

About the team  

This position reports to the Americas Trade Compliance Operations Sr Manager in the Global Trade Services (GTS) function. GTS is responsible for providing global trade and product compliance support for Amazon businesses, creating efficient processes that meet demanding cross border regulations, while minimizing impact to the business.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 4\+ years of compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with SQL and Excel
* Licensed Customs Broker

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  

  

Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how\-we\-hire/accommodations for more information. If the country/region you’re applying in isn’t listed, please contact your Recruiting Partner.  

The base salary range for this position is listed below. Your Amazon package will include sign\-on payments and restricted stock units (RSUs). Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave.
