**Program Manager, MC2**



Based in Washington, DC

  

The AFL\-CIO Working for America Institute (WAI) is a non\-profit, 501(c) (3\) national workforce development organization for the labor movement. WAI assists unions, employers, labor\-management partnerships, the workforce system, and community organizations by providing technical assistance, education, leadership development and policy analysis. WAI implements employment, apprenticeship, and training\-related services that help to create, expand, and retain high quality jobs.



WAI is seeking to hire a Program Manager who will work with the executive director and deputy director to implement and manage the deployment, national growth, and ongoing updating and improvement of the MC2 (Manufacturing Core Curriculum), a high quality pre\-hire/pre\-apprenticeship training curriculum to prepare workers for careers and apprenticeships in the manufacturing sector. The Program Manager will also work with local partners to implement associated training programs that utilize the MC2 curriculum. The Program Manager will lead program strategy and implementation, including achieving initial deployment/ utilization of MC2 and national expansion, developing workplans, ensuring the project meets workplan, performance, and other objectives and supporting fundraising efforts.



The position is based in Washington, D.C. and reports to the Deputy Director. Our hybrid schedule allows up to two days per week of remote work.

 **Description**  

*Project Leadership and Strategy*


* Lead the strategy and implementation of the project, which is a new universal pre\-apprenticeship/career and technical education curriculum to prepare workers for manufacturing entry\-level jobs and is at the early stage of implementation.
* Manage and oversee local deployment of associated high\-quality training utilizing the MC2
* Ensure that funds are used in accordance with the terms and conditions of grants


*Project Implementation*


* Work with the Deputy Director and project partners to develop and implement project strategies, goals, and objectives, including identifying promising local partners to utilize MC2, supporting development of their MC2 programs through technical assistance
* Oversee licensing of the MC2 curriculum and revenue generation.
* Develop and oversee short, medium, and long\-term workplans for several phases of work – including adoption, implementation, scaling, and maintenance– to ensure that activities, outcomes, and deliverables are achieved and meet required timelines.
* Develop promising practices to deliver strong project outcomes and gather models of best practices for replication and expansion.
* Lead updates to and maintenance of the curriculum.


*Partner management*

* Coordinate and lead meetings and communications with partners


*Communications and administrative oversight*


* In conjunction with the Executive Director and Deputy Director, hire and manage a team of project support staff, consultants, and contractors
* Identify opportunities to communicate project successes.
* Support project communications strategies and contribute to external communications, including outreach materials, website content, and materials and information for funders, the Board of Directors, and key stakeholders.
* Develop and track project budgets and expenditures and assist the Deputy Director in reviewing and managing the budgets.
* Oversee organization and maintenance of project files.

new_jobs.title: Senior Program Manager, Professional Services
new_jobs.description:
**Job description**
===================

**Senior Program Manager, Professional Services**

**Location:** DC/MD/VA Remote
  

**Clearance:** Active Top Secret / Sensitive Compartmented Information **(TS/SCI)** Security Clearance required
  

**Certification:** PMP Required


**POSITION OVERVIEW:**

Hitachi Federal is seeking an experienced **Senior Program Manager Professional Services** to lead the successful delivery, growth, and performance of a portfolio of complex federal technology engagements.


This role serves as a senior customer and delivery leader, with accountability for **customer satisfaction, program performance, financial management, resource planning, team development, and organic growth** across assigned engagements. The Senior Program Manager will partner across Professional Services, Sales, Finance, Contracts, Human Resources, and technical teams to ensure engagements are delivered successfully while identifying opportunities to expand our support of federal customers.


The ideal candidate is a PMP\-certified leader with deep experience managing complex federal IT programs involving software development, cloud, data, and infrastructure technologies. This individual combines disciplined program management with strong business acumen, executive\-level customer engagement, technical understanding, and a growth mindset.


This is a highly visible role for a leader who can manage the details of successful program execution while maintaining a broader view of customer needs, portfolio performance, and business growth.


**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:**

**Program \& Portfolio Leadership**

* Own the overall health and performance of an assigned portfolio of professional services engagements, including **delivery, schedule, financial performance, staffing, customer satisfaction, risk, and growth** .
* Serve as the primary Hitachi Federal program management point of contact with customers, prime contractors, partners, and other key stakeholders.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with customer stakeholders and executive leadership.
* Implement and coordinate service delivery across assigned programs to ensure execution against clearly defined scope, schedule, budget, and customer requirements.
* Maintain accountability for all program requirements, including technical delivery, budget, schedule, staffing, growth, contractual commitments, and overall performance.
* Establish and monitor appropriate program and portfolio KPIs, including schedule, budget, utilization, margin, customer satisfaction, and delivery performance.
* Proactively identify, manage, mitigate, and communicate program issues, risks, dependencies, and potential impacts.
* Manage resources across multiple projects and maintain visibility into staffing requirements, utilization, deliverables, schedules, and budgets.
* Conduct readiness reviews to ensure appropriate technical resources and administrative support are in place prior to project start dates.
* Participate in and lead monthly program management reviews, providing clear visibility into technical, financial, schedule, growth, risk, and performance metrics.
* Establish and enforce appropriate work standards and delivery practices to drive consistency, quality, accountability, and customer satisfaction.

**Customer \& Stakeholder Leadership**

* Establish trusted relationships with federal customers, prime contractors, partners, and internal stakeholders.
* Lead executive\-level customer governance, including program reviews, escalations, performance discussions, and strategic planning.
* Understand customer business and mission requirements and translate those needs into actionable technology and professional services solutions.
* Apply knowledge of industry trends and technologies across areas such as **infrastructure, cloud services, operations, data management and protection, data intelligence, data analytics, virtualization, and applications** .
* Ensure conformity with contractual obligations while maintaining appropriate technical and financial reporting to demonstrate program progress and performance.
* Coordinate project\-related activities across Hitachi Federal functions, including Professional Services, Sales, Solutions, Finance, Contracts, Staffing, and Human Resources.
* Communicate proactively and effectively with business, technical, customer, and executive stakeholders at all levels.

**Financial \& Operational Management**

* Own the financial health of assigned engagements in partnership with Finance, including **revenue forecasting, margin performance, labor utilization, invoicing, budget management, and variance analysis** .
* Reconcile actual labor hours and costs against project budgets and forecasts.
* Work closely with Finance to ensure accurate time reporting, invoicing, revenue forecasting, and financial visibility.
* Manage subcontractor performance and ensure alignment with contractual requirements, delivery expectations, and program objectives.
* Develop and maintain comprehensive cost, schedule, performance, and risk reporting.
* Identify opportunities to improve delivery processes, eliminate duplication, increase accuracy, and create greater efficiency and scalability across Professional Services.
* Develop and maintain Statements of Work, Work Breakdown Structures, project plans, schedules, and other program documentation necessary for successful execution.

**Growth \& Business Development**

* Proactively identify opportunities for **contract extensions, follow\-on work, scope expansion, recompetes, and new professional services engagements** within existing customer relationships.
* Understand evolving customer challenges and identify opportunities that may be addressed through Hitachi technologies, solutions, or professional services.
* Communicate identified growth opportunities to Sales, Capture, Contracts, Professional Services, and senior leadership and support their transition into the growth pipeline.
* Partne

This is a full\-time opportunity. We can offer a competitive salary, and a comprehensive benefits package.

* Communicate and coordinate with teams to accomplish objectives and deliver excellence

* Visualize, interpret, and report data findings, and create dynamic data reports

  

**REQUIRED QUALIFICATIONS*** Three (3\) to ten (10\) years of directly related experience
* Available to work onsite in Arlington, VA 1\-2 days per week
* Professional dashboard\-development experience using business intelligence software such as Qlik Sense, Tableau, or Power BI
* Excellent communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with cross\-functional teams
* Detail\-oriented mindset with a commitment to delivering high\-quality results

new_jobs.title: Senior Transportation Services Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
At Significance, we believe the best results come from investing in great people. As a woman\-owned consulting firm supporting federal civilian and Department of Defense customers, we bring together talented professionals who are passionate about solving complex challenges and making a meaningful impact.



We're proud of the culture we've built \- one rooted in trust, collaboration, respect, and genuine relationships. Our people are empowered to share ideas, grow their careers, and deliver exceptional results while supporting missions that matter. It's a culture we're proud of, and one that has earned us recognition as a Washington Business Journal Best Place to Work for seven consecutive years.

  

Significance, Inc. is seeking a **Senior Transportation Services Business Analyst** to support an upcoming federal program (contingent upon award).



We are seeking an experienced and highly analytical Senior Business Analyst to support the Transportation Services (TS) division within the Department of Health and Human Services (HHS). The ideal candidate will have advanced Microsoft Excel skills, along with experience in budget forecasting, accounting principles, and data mining and analysis. The selected candidate will play a key role in supporting critical budget and funding activities across TS while helping drive program efficiency through process improvement and automation.

  


### **Required Skills:**

* Responsible for the monthly client billing cycle and funding processes; driving client communications and follow up on required client actions for all lines of business within Transportation Services (TS)
* Responsible for working with the Federal Team on ensuring FY funding contracts are created, submitted, executed, finalized to properly establish in the HHS Invoicing system for client billing.
* Responsible for tracking and maintaining reporting on funding status, client utilization, forecasting and identifying variances to ensure the Department’s required recovery on services provided.
* Develop and maintain advanced Excel\-based financial models for budget forecasting, variance analysis, and trend reporting.
* Analyze and manage complex datasets related to operations and client billing.
* Provide monthly, quarterly, and annual budget reports to HHS leadership and stakeholders.
* Support funding processes, billing reconciliation, and accounting processes for Transit customers.
* Conduct data mining to uncover cost\-saving opportunities and operational inefficiencies.
* Collaborate with program managers, finance teams, vendors, and IT to gather business requirements and translate them into analytical solutions.
* Create and maintain dashboards and visualizations to communicate findings clearly and effectively.
* Ensure compliance with all federal and departmental financial regulations and reporting requirements.
* Recommend and implement process improvements and automation strategies using Excel and other tools.
* Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Public Policy, or a related field.
* 5\+ years of progressive experience as a Business Analyst or Financial Analyst, preferably in a government or public sector environment.
* Expert\-level proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including PivotTables, advanced formulas, VLOOKUP, Power Query, Power Pivot, and VBA/macros.
* Strong understanding of budgeting, forecasting, cost analysis, and financial reporting.
* Demonstrated ability to extract, clean, and analyze large datasets from multiple sources; experience in generating multiple reports from varying data sources on credit card/transit program trends/behaviors


* Proven experience in data mining and trend analysis to support analyzing and presenting program specific data and translating into key business decisions.

new_jobs.description:
**This is a temporary position not to exceed a duration of 6 months \- 1 year.**

  



The All\-Source Intelligence Analyst –Junior supports the client in developing, providing, and integrating timely, insightful, objective, and relevant all\-source intelligence analysis into the agency’s operations. The goal is to inform leadership decisions regarding defense of critical infrastructure and enable the agency, its partners throughout SLTT and private sector to identify, mitigate, and respond to threats as appropriate.

  

This position aligns with Cayuse’s core values of Innovation, Excellence, Collaboration, Adaptability, and Integrity by fostering technical solutions that meet customer needs, promoting teamwork, and prioritizing quality in deliverables.

  

* Support data fusion from various data inputs and sources, including reported intrusion\-network status from client Threat Hunting analysis, open source, and law enforcement and intelligence inputs to look for trends across Critical Infrastructure (CI).
* Provide research, analytic, or operational support regarding infrastructure threats across CI sectors and their sub\-sectors.
* Coordinate with the Intelligence Community (IC) and Component partners to consolidate all available information, to include facilitating/tracking classified Requests for Information and Requests for Action (RFIs/RFAs).
* Research and analyze all\-source threats, vulnerabilities, and risks to CI and develop all\-hazards consequence analysis products in support of the mission, to include independent or collaborative development of written, graphic, or visual products in the steady state and incident response product lines.
* Coordinate, research, develop, and deliver work on pre\-planned Intelligence products in support of agency program of analysis, analytic requirements, ad\-hoc tasks, and incident response requirements.
* Write Intelligence estimates, products, or quick turn responses to senior leadership questions in the form of In Response to Your Question (IRQ), Intelligence Note, etc. within requested timeframe established by senior leadership.
* Provide technical review and editing of all types of written and graphics\-based products developed, to include, but are not limited to, all analytic products, graphics, and strategic and policy documents.
* Support development, administration and management of Priority Intelligence/Information Requirements.
* Edit and review all intelligence products to ensure products conform to style and standards guidelines and adhere to analytic tradecraft standards.
* Track written and graphics\-based products through the overall production cycle to include the tracking of requirements used to develop products.
* Support the development or refinement of intelligence templates, standard operating procedures, guides, standards and other policy directives, and instructions.
* Facilitate/track subdivision\-directed RFIs and coordinate internally and externally to obtain more information or with the IC and other agency components.
* Support incident response efforts that may require after hours, weekends, or shift work.
* Other duties as assigned.

  

* Must have a minimum of 2 to 3 years of related experience.
* Additional (4\) four years of military and/or operations environment experience may be substituted with a high school diploma.
* Active Top Secret/SCI security clearance and DHS Fitness.
* Must be able to pass a background check. May require additional background checks as required by projects and/or clients at any time during employment.

**Minimum Skills:**

* Ability to clearly articulate intelligence requirements into well\-formulated research questions and data tracking variables for inquiry tracking purposes.
* Ability to communicate complex information, concepts, or ideas in a confident and well\-organized manner through verbal, written, and/or visual means.
* Ability to evaluate, analyze, and synthesize large quantities of data (which may be fragmented and contradictory) into high quality, fused targeting/intelligence products.
* Ability to recognize and mitigate cognitive biases, which may affect analysis.
* Ability to think critically.
* Knowledge of intelligence confidence levels.
* Knowledge of threat and/or target systems.
* Skill in identifying alternative analytical interpretations in order to minimize unanticipated outcomes.
* High proficiency in Microsoft Office; including but not limited to: Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Publisher, and other general software applications.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Bachelor’s Degree in a related discipline such as Homeland Security or Business, or an additional two (2\) years of experience with an Associate’s Degree.

**Our Commitment to you / overview of benefits**

* Medical, Dental and Vision Insurance; Wellness Program
* Flexible Spending Accounts (Healthcare, Dependent Care, Commuter)
* Short\-Term and Long\-Term Disability options
* Basic Life and AD\&D Insurance (Company Provided)
* Voluntary Life and AD\&D options
* 401(k) Retirement Savings Plan with matching after one year
* Paid Time Off

**Reports to: Program Manager**

* Professional office environment, with the ability to work onsite in the main office.
* Must be physically and mentally able to perform duties extended periods of time.

new_jobs.title: Cyber Threat Operations Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
*By joining the National Student Clearinghouse, you can be sure that the work you do now will help shape the future of education and the workforce in the U.S. As the trusted source for higher education data since 1993, the Clearinghouse is the leading provider of transcript and data exchange services, automated enrollment and degree verifications, learner insights and research, and compliance solutions for schools, businesses, and learners nationwide. As a 501(c)(3\) nonprofit organization, the Clearinghouse works with nearly 3,600 postsecondary institutions to meet their compliance needs and with thousands of high schools and districts to provide continuing collegiate enrollment, progression, and completion statistics about their alumni. In addition, the Research Center publications inform policymakers and business leaders about student educational pathways. Using our unique combination of data, analytics, and software to drive our mission, security and privacy is paramount. Join us as we continue to invest in our talent and new advanced technologies to unlock the power of data on behalf of all learners.*

**About the Role:**
-------------------


The Technical Specialist, Threat Operations serves as a senior operational leader and key partner within the Cyber Operations team, acting as the functional second\-in\-command across threat operations activities. This role is responsible for building, scaling, and sustaining a comprehensive threat operations program that translates threat and exposure signals into actionable insights and business risk decisions.


This position combines hands\-on operational oversight—including detection, triage, investigation, and response—with ownership of strategic program elements such as threat intelligence, lifecycle governance, and Continuous Threat Exposure Management (CTEM). The role also requires leadership through influence, driving consistent execution, talent development, and high\-quality outcomes across analysts, partners, and stakeholders.


The Technical Specialist, Threat Operations is expected to maximize AI\-assisted and agentic AI workflows while maintaining human accountability, secure data handling, and audit\-ready evidence. All outputs must remain defensible, traceable, and aligned with enterprise governance standards.


Currently, this is a remote\-first position, and this position may be required to periodically work on\-site at our office and the frequency would depend on the department/division's requirements. Therefore, candidates must either reside within a reasonable distance to commute to our office or be willing to travel to our office in Herndon, when required.


**How You Contribute:**
-----------------------


* Demonstrate the Clearinghouse's core competencies: Customer Focus, Optimizes Work Processes, Collaborates, Communicates Effectively, and Be Open and Authentic.
* Oversee detection, triage, and validation of security alerts, ensuring timely and evidence\-based disposition.
* Translate technical findings into clear risk\-based recommendations and actionable next steps.
* Serve as escalation lead during high\-severity incidents, ensuring proper scoping, documentation, and remediation to closure.
* Develop and mature the threat operations program roadmap, including CTEM strategy and operating model.
* Perform business\-centric threat modeling to align adversary activity with enterprise risk and impact.
* Define governance frameworks, including prioritization logic, escalation criteria, and executive reporting.
* Design and continuously improve repeatable workflows, including AI\-assisted triage, investigation, and reporting processes.
* Establish and manage key performance indicators (e.g., MTTD, MTTR, detection quality, noise reduction).
* Maintain playbooks, investigation templates, and escalation workflows to ensure consistency and audit readiness.
* Drive continuous improvement of detection fidelity through tuning and feedback loops.
* Implement AI\-assisted workflows with clear human\-in\-the\-loop validation and decision points.
* Ensure secure handling of sensitive data and alignment with enterprise AI governance policies.
* Validate AI outputs for accuracy and reliability and mitigate known risks such as hallucinations, bias, or incomplete context.
* Harden AI processes against adversarial threats (e.g., prompt injection, data leakage).
* Lead the threat intelligence lifecycle, including requirements, collection, analysis, dissemination, and feedback.
* Translate intelligence into actionable outputs such as threat hunts, detection priorities, and control validation.
* Deliver executive\-ready threat assessments with clear sourcing and confidence levels.
* Establish operating rhythms and performance expectations with external security partners.
* Ensure alignment with MITRE ATT\&CK coverage and measurable detection and response outcomes.
* Integrate partner outputs into internal workflows, ensuring accountability and closure of findings.
* Lead investigations involving cloud control plane threats (such as AWS and OCI), focusing on identity and configuration risks.

Job Title: C\-UAS Operations Analyst
Job Category: Intelligence
Time Type: Full time
Minimum Clearance Required to Start: TS/SCI
Employee Type: Regular
Percentage of Travel Required: Up to 25%
Type of Travel: Local
\* \* \*
**The Opportunity:**

CACI is seeking a Operations Analyst to assist with technical analysis and development of strategies for C\-UAS operations, readiness, and force structure. As a Operations Analyst, you will evaluate complex challenges, conduct war\-gaming and simulations, and provide data\-driven recommendations for senior leaders on warfighting concepts and resource management.
  

  

**Responsibilities:**

* Conduct all\-source analysis and assist in the collection and dissemination of information to U.S. and coalition forces, on a need\-to\-know basis, concerning target device TTPs, technology, and safe handling procedures.
* Utilize various intelligence disciplines (e.g. TECHINT, SIGINT/CYBER, HUMINT, MASINT, etc.) from all levels of classified information.
* Provide expertise and operational analysis for C\-UAS operations across one or more warfighting domains.
* Analyze service\-specific requirements, operational concepts, and Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures (TTPs) for C\-UAS employment.
* Conduct operational analysis of C\-UxS threats, vulnerabilities, and capability gaps within the assigned domain.
* Develop and recommend domain\-specific C\-UAS solutions, integration strategies, and operational procedures.
* Coordinate with service component representatives, Joint staff, and interagency partners to ensure C\-UAS capabilities meet domain\-specific operational requirements.
* Support test events, training exercises, and vulnerability assessments with domain expertise.
* Prepare analytical reports, briefings, and recommendations for senior leaders and stakeholders.

  

**Qualifications:**  

  

*Required:*

* Active TS//SCI Security Clearance.
* Requires completion of formal military intelligence school or IC equivalent school/training.
* BA/BS and 4\+ years of experience; AA/AS with 8\+ years; HS/GED with 10\+ years of recent specialized experience.
* Demonstrated understanding of threat device engineering and function.
* Expert understanding of C\-UAS layered defense.
* Proven ability to integrate UAS and C\-UAS TTPs into operational and intelligence planning.
* The ability to identify UAS to provide analysis to identify trends on target devices and TTPs.
* Possess strong research, analytical, and writing skills as well as briefing skills to include the ability to clearly articulate information to different audiences.
* Ability to generate/provide specialized analytical and technical products.
* Proficient in utilizing specialized tools to create final products.

  

*Desired:*

* Knowledge of and ability to perform analysis on the latest Commercial Based Technologies (CBT) and Emerging Technologies that could be utilized by adversaries and articulate how use of that CBT would affect DoD capability.
* Detailed understanding of various UAS platforms (aerial, ground, maritime).
* Knowledge of C\-UAS detection, tracking, and mitigation technologies.
* Familiarity with electromagnetic spectrum operations related to C\-UAS.

  

*

**A culture of integrity.**

At CACI, we place character and innovation at the center of everything we do. As a valued team member, you’ll be part of a high\-performing group dedicated to our customer’s missions and driven by a higher purpose – to ensure the safety of our nation.

CACI values the unique contributions that every employee brings to our company and our customers \- every day. You’ll have the autonomy to take the time you need through a unique flexible time off benefit and have access to robust learning resources to make your ambitions a reality.


**A focus on continuous growth.**

Together, we will advance our nation's most critical missions, build on our lengthy track record of business success, and find opportunities to break new ground — in your career and in our legacy.

  

  

**Pay Range** :


There are a host of factors that can influence final salary including, but not limited to, geographic location, Federal Government contract labor categories and contract wage rates, relevant prior work experience, specific skills and competencies, education, and certifications. Our employees value the flexibility at CACI that allows them to balance quality work and their personal lives. We offer competitive compensation, benefits and learning and development opportunities. Our broad and competitive mix of benefits options is designed to support and protect employees and their families. $109,800 \- $241,600

The Senior Business Operations Manager plays a critical, integrative role within the Contracting Office, serving as a connective tissue between contracting, subcontract management, finance, program operations, and executive leadership. new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Business Analyst
new_jobs.description:
**Technical Business Analyst**Location: Falls Church, VA (on\-site in office, with partial telework flexibility)  

Full\-Time \| Permanent  

Salary Range: $70,000\.00 \~ $115,000\.00  

  

BizFlow is hiring experienced **Technical Business Analysts** to help drive a large\-scale enterprise modernization program. This is one of several analyst positions we are adding to the program team, alongside program management, project management, and engineering hires. If you are a strong facilitator who can hold the big picture and the process detail at the same time, own the requirements\-to\-acceptance thread on complex software implementations, and lead customers to clear decisions, we would like to hear from you.  

This is not an entry\-level role. **Hands\-on software implementation experience is required.** You have taken software solutions from requirements through UAT and go\-live, and you know where implementations succeed and fail.  

  

**What You’ll Do:**  

You will own the connective tissue between the customer and the delivery team: eliciting and documenting high\-quality requirements, guiding customer stakeholders to the right decisions, translating business needs into buildable specifications, and leading User Acceptance Testing through to sign\-off. You will work alongside the program manager and project manager, who own program governance and delivery execution, and a growing engineering team that builds the solution. Your lane is the requirements\-to\-acceptance thread that keeps everyone aligned.  

  

**Facilitate implementation*** Serve as the primary analyst on customer implementations within the modernization program, keeping the solution traceable from business goal to delivered feature.
* Partner with engineers and QA to clarify requirements, triage defects, and support testing as the build progresses.
* Feed clean, well\-scoped requirements and acceptance results into the project manager’s schedule and the program manager’s governance, surfacing risks and dependencies early.

**Capture clear, high\-quality requirements*** Lead interviews, workshops, and elicitation sessions with business and technical stakeholders.
* Write user stories, use cases, and functional specifications with well\-formed acceptance criteria.
* Build As\-Is and To\-Be process flows and translate them into specifications the engineering team can act on without guesswork.
* Refine and prioritize the backlog and maintain traceability from business goals to delivered features.

**Lead and influence the customer*** Guide customer stakeholders across business, operations, product, and QA toward clear, timely decisions.
* Translate ambiguity into structured options, and drive alignment where interests compete, through influence rather than authority.
* Balance scope, value, risk, and constraints through negotiation, and build the trust that makes you the customer’s go\-to voice on the solution.

**Lead and facilitate UAT*** Own acceptance testing end to end: define test scenarios from the requirements, prepare and guide customer testers, and validate outcomes against acceptance criteria.
* Drive the resolution and re\-test cycle through to formal sign\-off.

**Essential Qualifications:*** Bachelor’s degree in a related field, or equivalent practical experience.
* 8\+ years hands\-on software implementation experience, from requirements through UAT and go\-live.
* Excellent communication and facilitation skills, with a proven ability to lead a room and move stakeholders to decisions.
* The ability to quickly grasp the big picture while deep\-diving into process detail.
* Requirements elicitation and documentation: leading interviews and workshops, writing user stories and use cases, and defining acceptance criteria.
* Direct experience working with development and QA teams to clarify requirements, triage defects, and support testing and UAT.
* Process modeling: creating As\-Is / To\-Be process flows and translating them into functional specifications.
* Backlog management: refining and prioritizing items and maintaining traceability from business goals to delivered features.
* Cross\-functional stakeholder communication across business, product, QA, and operations.
* Analytical and problem\-solving strength: gap analysis, impact assessment, and solution evaluation.
* Clear translation of business needs into technical requirements, and technical constraints back into business terms.
* Acceptance testing support: defining test scenarios and validating outcomes against requirements.
* Data fundamentals, including using Excel for data validation and requirement clarification.
* Foundational business analysis training, such as coursework in requirements analysis, process modeling, or Agile BA fundamentals.
* Working understanding of the SDLC (phases, deliverables, roles) and Agile fundamentals (Scrum ceremonies and artifacts, epics and user stories, acceptance criteria).
* US Citizen or Permanent Resident.

**Preferred Qualifications:*** Professional certifications: CBAP or CCBA (IIBA), PMI\-PBA, an Agile BA certification, or a Scrum certification (CSM / PSPO).
* Technical fluency: a conceptual understanding of APIs, data models, and integration.
* Automation or low\-code experience with tools such as BizFlow AppDev, ServiceNow workflows, or other BPM suites.
* Proficiency with documentation and collaboration tools such as Confluence, SharePoint, Jira, and diagramming tools like Visio.
* Prototyping and wireframing with tools such as BizFlow AppDev, Pencil, or Balsamiq for UI/UX collaboration.
* Advanced facilitation: design\-thinking workshops, story mapping, and impact mapping.
* Intermediate data skills, including familiarity with SQL and data mapping.
* Change management experience: stakeholder adoption strategies, training plans, and communications.
* Delivery in regulated or compliance\-heavy environments, including accessibility standards such as Section 508\.
* Domain experience in HR, healthcare

* Customer\-service mindset with strong stakeholder engagement skills.

* Ability to balance strategic objectives with detailed requirements analysis.
* Adaptable, dependable, self\-motivated, and able to work independently.
* General understanding of DevOps principles and software delivery practices.
* Experience with requirements management and collaboration tools.
* Experience creating, managing, and maintaining knowledge repositories and project documentation.

* Experience with Appian, Jira, or similar low\-code and Agile delivery platforms.
* Experience supporting government, public sector, or large enterprise technology modernization initiatives.

new_jobs.title: Multiple Award BPA Program Manager
new_jobs.description:
540 is looking for a Multiple Award BPA Program Manager that will lead the overall management, growth, execution, and delivery of a large\-scale federal Multiple Award Blanket Purchase Agreement (BPA) or Indefinite Delivery/Indefinite Quantity (IDIQ) contract vehicle. This person will serve as the senior leader responsible for coordinating task order capture and proposal efforts, managing awarded task orders, overseeing subcontractors and teaming partners, ensuring strong contractual and financial performance, and maintaining trusted customer relationships throughout the life of the vehicle.



This role requires extensive experience leading technology\-focused federal contract vehicles at significant scale, including Multiple Award BPAs or IDIQs valued at $500M or greater and responsibility for portfolios exceeding $100M in awarded task orders. The ideal candidate has successfully managed multiple concurrent task orders from opportunity identification and proposal development through award, transition, delivery, performance management, and closeout.



This position will support a large and evolving federal technology portfolio that may include software development, cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, data, artificial intelligence, systems integration, and digital modernization efforts.


**Location**: Hybrid in Arlington, VA  

**Citizenship \& Clearance Requirement**: Per client requirements, candidates must be U.S. Citizens with the ability to obtain and maintain a Public Trust clearance  

**Education Requirement:** Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Computer Science, Engineering, Management Information Systems, or another relevant technical or business discipline  

**540 Internal Thrive Level:** Principal Project Manager


**WHY 540?**



540 is a forward\-thinking company that the government turns to in order to \#getshitdone. We don't just talk about innovation – we deliver it. We break down barriers, build impactful technology, and solve mission\-critical problems.


**HOW YOU'LL DRIVE IMPACT**


* Provide executive\-level management and oversight of a federal Multiple Award BPA or IDIQ with a total contract value of at least $500M and a significant portfolio of awarded task orders
* Manage multiple concurrent task orders of varying size, scope, technical complexity, contract type, customer, and period of performance
* Lead the full task order lifecycle, including opportunity assessment and qualification, capture strategy, solution development, proposal planning and development, pricing coordination, proposal submission, negotiations, award transition, staffing, delivery, performance management, modifications, option periods, and closeout
* Partner closely with business development, capture, solution architecture, proposal, contracts, pricing, recruiting, finance, and delivery teams to develop compliant and competitive task order responses
* Manage multiple subcontractors and teaming partners, including workshare commitments, subcontractor performance, staffing, deliverables, financial management, and contractual compliance
* Establish and maintain integrated governance across all task orders to ensure consistent program management, reporting, quality, risk management, financial controls, and customer engagement
* Monitor task order performance against contractual requirements, schedules, budgets, staffing plans, SLAs, KPIs, and other performance measures
* Identify and resolve program\-level risks, issues, dependencies, staffing challenges, and performance concerns across the task order portfolio
* Maintain visibility into BPA\-level and task order\-level financial performance, including revenue, funding, burn rates, labor utilization, subcontractor costs, forecasts, and profitability
* Serve as a senior point of contact with Government contracting, program, technical, and acquisition leadership
* Lead regular program reviews, customer meetings, subcontractor reviews, and executive reporting
* Support BPA growth by identifying upcoming task order opportunities, understanding customer priorities, shaping requirements where appropriate, and coordinating task order pursuit strategies
* Ensure compliance with applicable contract requirements, Federal Acquisition Regulation provisions, organizational policies, security requirements, and quality\-management processes
* Develop repeatable task order management processes, templates, dashboards, metrics, and governance mechanisms that support efficient execution across a large and evolving portfolio


**REQUIRED SKILLS \& EXPERIENCE**


* 10\+ years of progressively responsible experience managing federal government programs, Multiple Award BPAs, IDIQs, Governmentwide Acquisition Contracts (GWACs), or similar large contract vehicles
* Demonstrated experience managing a Multiple Award BPA or IDIQ valued at $500M or greater, including responsibility for a portfolio exceeding $100M in awarded task orders
* Demonstrated experience managing technology\-focused BPAs or IDIQs involving one or more of the following: software development, cloud, DevSecOps, cybersecurity, data, artificial intelligence, systems integration, or digital modernization
* Demonstrated experience simultaneously managing multiple active task orders involving diverse customers, technical requirements, delivery teams, and contractual obligations

new_jobs.title: SCIF_SAPF Project Manager
new_jobs.description:
The Mission Concepts and Capabilities (MCC) Division of Applied Research Associates, Inc. (ARA) has an exciting opportunity for a full\-time S**ensitive Compartmented Information Facilities (SCIFs) and Special Access Program (SAPF) Facilities Project Manager** at a location in the Arlington or Falls Church, VA area. The potential candidate will provide support to the Office of the Assistant Secretary of War for Nuclear Deterrence, Chemical, and Biological Defense, Policy and Programs by supporting the strategic planning, design, physical and technical security implementation, accreditation lifecycle, ongoing security management, and ultimate turnover of all secure spaces across the enterprise.


**Essential Functions:**


* Project\-Level SCIF Accreditation \& Security Governance by establishing the security architecture and compliance baseline across the entire facility portfolio, ensuring that all physical, technical, and operational security requirements remain intact from design through lifecycle management.
* Secure Facility Operations \& Lifetime SCIF Management overseeing activities beyond initial accreditation through continuous oversight of the accredited spaces and maintaining their security integrity.
* Portfolio \& Project Management by managing the strategic execution, integration, and risk profiles of multiple concurrent secure\-space initiatives.
* Technical Infrastructure \& Network Security Architecture by possessing technical literacy to oversee the complex engineering systems required for accredited secure environments.
* Government Contracting \& Stakeholder Integration by operating within a complex, highly regulated defense environment, acting as the central interface between multiple government and corporate entities.

**Required Skills:**

**DESCRIPTION**
---------------


Amazon is looking for a Senior Trade Compliance Program Manager (PM) to build import and export risk management solutions for growing international businesses in the Trade Operations space. The Senior Trade Compliance PM, is responsible for managing the strategy of a complex cross\-functional risk program independently.  

  

As a leader within the Global Trade Services team, you will help develop and hire team capabilities, as well as mentor and train colleagues. You will manage the Trade Operations Program team, that works directly with internal teams from legal, logistics, supply chain, quality, engineering, as well as Amazon's global network of trade and compliance teams.  

  

Key job responsibilities  

Set processes for Broker Management activities and liaise with brokers and other participants in the supply chain on a daily basis.  

Act as the main point of contact for regulators across the Trade space in North America.  

Set objectives, and drive improvements to your space and quantify with metrics.  

Partner with internal and external stakeholders including business teams, tech teams, public policy, trade, legal, and regulators to interpret and apply regulations.  

Oversee the rollout of controls and audits, including testing and measuring their effectiveness.  

Build flexible and scalable solutions across various customized technologies, business models/supply chain arcs, and country regulatory regimes.  

Stay informed on regulations and technologies relevant to your space and bring them into your risk management programs.  

Present organized plans to articulate the problem statement, the recommended solution, and milestones.  

Identify timelines and owners, and drive progress at the appropriate speed to reduce risk.  

Drive alignment by providing near and long term considerations and impacts, and highlight recommended trade\-offs and priorities.  

Drive the best way forward and build consensus when confronted with discordant views.  

Test assumptions by getting feedback from the right input providers across the company, and review metrics and benchmarks.  

Work with business intelligence engineers and technology teams to design, build and track key performance indicators and systems.  

Communicate risks, proposals, regulatory updates and strategies to internal and external stakeholders in meetings and documents.  

  

A day in the life  

As a Program Manager, you will manage escalations and meet with multiple stakeholders across different time zones to move business forward.  

  

About the team  

This position reports to the Americas Trade Compliance Operations Sr Manager in the Global Trade Services (GTS) function. GTS is responsible for providing global trade and product compliance support for Amazon businesses, creating efficient processes that meet demanding cross border regulations, while minimizing impact to the business.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 4\+ years of compliance program management, legal, governance, audit, risk/loss prevention, or equivalent experience
* Bachelor's degree or equivalent

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience with SQL and Excel
* Licensed Customs Broker

  

Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.

Final compensation will be determined based on factors including experience, qualifications, and location. Amazon also offers comprehensive benefits including health insurance (medical, dental, vision, prescription, Basic Life \& AD\&D insurance and option for Supplemental life plans, EAP, Mental Health Support, Medical Advice Line, Flexible Spending Accounts, Adoption and Surrogacy Reimbursement coverage), 401(k) matching, paid time off, and parental leave. ### **Position Description \& Qualifications**

  

  

Serco is excited to continue supporting the F\-35 Joint Strike Fighter Program Office (JPO). This contract provides program management support in support of the full acquisition lifecycle of the F\-35 program, to include development, production, and sustainment.


The F\-35 JPO International Directorate (ID) is the focal point for all F\-35 Fleet Users, to include U.S. Services, International Partners, and Foreign Military Sales programs to ensure ID integration throughout the F\-35 enterprise and to ensure the delivery of 5th Generation combat capability to Warfighters in support of coalition operations. The Contractor shall provide support to the National Deputies who are the F\-35 Program’s senior national representative for their Participant country within the JSF Program Office and are responsible for providing day\-to\-day representation of the cognizant Partner nation on all matters related to the F\-35 Program. The Contractor shall provide support to the U.S. Service Deputies who are assigned to the JPO to ensure immediate/critical U.S. Service insight to the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) and Senior Leadership Team (SLT). The Contractor shall provide support to the Foreign Military Sales USG Program Managers who represent the Foreign Military Sales Foreign Liaison Officers for country within the JSF Program Office and are responsible for providing day\-to\-day representation of the cognizant Foreign Military Sales nation on all matters related to the F\-35 Program.


Our **Foreign Military Sales (FMS) Program Analyst,** F\-35 Joint Program Office (JPO), Crystal City, Arlington, VA, is responsible for advising JPO FMS leadership on current security cooperation policy, case development and case execution practices. Our Analyst reports to the Business Policy and Operations Manager, who is the principal policy and financial advisor to the FMS Program Manager, responsible for ensuring the FMS Program is in accordance with the Secretary of the Air Force International Affairs (SAF/IA), and Navy International Programs Office (NIPO) policies and procedures. Focus areas include: security cooperation and security assistance policy; manpower requirements; development, implementation, and execution of FMS cases; Letter of Request (LOR)/Letter of Offer and Acceptance (LOA) inputs, to include amendments and modifications; and process improvement.


You will be part of a dynamic team of F\-35 JPO Program Analysts and Program/Project Managers who works closely with the customer and other key F\-35 National Security and Allied stakeholders to deliver quality F\-35 systems.


In this role, you will:


* Provide expert management in the areas of security cooperation policy, case development, and case execution.
* Interact with cross\-functional agencies, to include SAF/IA, NIPO, AFSAC, and NAVAIR, to ensure current FMS policies and procedures support the function of the F\-35 FMS Program.
* Review and interpret directives from higher authority regulations, instructions, periodicals, and publications to maintain current expertise and knowledge.
* Ensure new technology and lessons learned are incorporated into F\-35 FMS processes; establishes suitable methods of assessing and continually improving processes.
* Develop, evaluate, advise, and improve efficiency and effectiveness of work methods and procedures, and manpower utilization.
* Coordinate with FMS Program Managers to advise and support country teams in the areas of policy, case development, and case execution.
* Coordinate with Security Cooperation Enterprise to assist country teams in completing Pricing and Availability (P\&A), Letters of Offer and Acceptance (LOAs), amendment and modification packages in Security Cooperation systems, including DSAMS and RMIS.
* Use strong communication skills including the ability to communicate orally, via written letters and memorandum, email, and presentation. Ability to prepare and present convincing oral and written presentations at all levels of government and industry, and foreign allies.
* Manage Annual Case Reviews (ACR) required by the DSCA Reconciliation and Closure Manual (RCM), DoD 5105\.65\-M, is completed in a timely manner.

To be successful in this role, you will have:


* The ability to provide onsite support at the F\-35 Joint Program Office (JPO) at Crystal City, VA a minimum of 2 days per week, each week. Onsite days in the JPO office may increase to provide onsite support up to 5 days per week to support the needs of the customer. Exact days in office at the JPO must be coordinated with F\-35 customer and approved by your Serco manager.
* An active DoD Secret Security clearance.
* A Bachelor’s degree plus a minimum of 3 years out of 6 years of recent work experience related to international acquisition programs.
	+ OR an Associates degree and 4 years of additional work experience related to international acquisition programs (total of 10 years of work experience).
* Familiarity with DoD Instruction (DoDI) 5000\.2 (Operation of the Defense Acquisition System), DoD Directive (DODD) 5530\.03 (International Agreements), and the International Cooperation in Acquisition, Technology and Logistics (IC in AT\&L) Handbook.
* Demonstrated knowledge of the principles, policies, and practices of system acquisition to plan, organize, and coordinate critical aspects of the development, production, deployment, and sustainment of systems, subsystems, and equipment.
* Demonstrated knowledge of the Security Assistance/Security Cooperation (SA/SC) programs to include the understanding of the FMS sales process from case development, implementation, execution, to closure in accordance with the Security Assistance Management Manual (SAMM), DoD 5105

new_jobs.description:
**About Us**  

Visa is a world leader in payments technology, facilitating transactions between consumers, merchants, financial institutions and government entities across more than 200 countries and territories, dedicated to uplifting everyone, everywhere by being the best way to pay and be paid.


At Visa, you'll have the opportunity to create impact at scale — tackling meaningful challenges, growing your skills and seeing your contributions impact lives around the world.


Join Visa and do work that matters – to you, to your community, and to the world. Progress starts with you.

**Job Description**


Information security is an integral part of Visa's corporate culture. It is essential to maintain our position as an industry leader in electronic payments, which is why Visa has made it a priority to create top\-tier security operations and incident response teams to defend the company against evolving cyber threats. If you would like to join a company where security is truly valued, where you can work with like\-minded peers who are passionate about the art \& science of cyber defense, and where you can use state of the art tools for maximum impact, then we have a home for you.


The successful candidate will work with a team of incident responders at one of Visa's Cyber Fusion Centers. The team is part of a larger organization located across multiple geographical sites that are responsible for the comprehensive cyber defense of Visa and its subsidiaries.


Essential Functions:

* Manage and address cybersecurity incidents through all stages, including identification, containment, and eradication.
* Perform deep\-dive analysis on systems, accounts, and networks to identify the root cause and impact of incidents.
* Act as an engagement point for broader technology teams, including Cyber Defense and Engineering.
* Perform proactive threat hunting to identify and mitigate potential threats before they can cause harm.
* Develop and refine detection rules to improve the identification and response to security incidents.
* Provide detailed reports and documentation of incidents and response actions.
* Conduct quality control of the work performed by analysts to ensure accuracy and thoroughness.
* Mentor and train junior analysts in advanced incident response techniques, tactics, and procedures.
* Develop and maintain incident response playbooks and runbooks to ensure standardized and efficient response processes.
* Contribute to identifying process improvement opportunities to enhance security incident response processes.
* Implement process automation to streamline incident response workflows and improve efficiency.
* Support and manage cybersecurity projects to enhance overall security posture.


Visa requires at least 3 days in office, expectations of these days will be confirmed by your Hiring Manager.

**Qualifications**


Basic Qualifications:

* 5\+ years of relevant work experience with a Bachelor’s Degree or at least 2 years of work experience with an Advanced degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or 0 years of work experience with a PhD, OR 8\+ years of relevant work experience.


Preferred Qualifications:

* 6 or more years of work experience with a bachelor’s degree or 4 or more years of relevant experience with an Advanced Degree (e.g. Masters, MBA, JD, MD) or up to 3 years of relevant experience with a PhD.
* Proven subject matter expertise in relevant areas, such as incident response, threat hunting, malware analysis, web application security or security engineering.
* 3\+ years of Security Operations Center (SOC) work experience with a bachelor’s degree.
* Bachelor’s degree in computer science, information systems, or related technical discipline or equivalent professional experience related to Cybersecurity, Incident Response or information security.
* Experience working in an enterprise\-level incident response team or security operations center.
* Relevant security\-related certifications a plus: CISSP, GCIH, GCIA, GCED, GCFA, CySA\+.
* Demonstrated expertise in areas like incident response, intrusion and malware analysis, web application security, or security engineering.
* Extensive understanding of malware types and network attack methods.
* Strong grasp of TCP/IP, packet analysis, routing, and network security.
* Extensive expertise in operating systems (Windows and Linux), as well as network services and applications.
* Direct experience in handling cyber security incidents and associated incident response tools.
* Strong working knowledge of common security tools such as SIEM, AV, WAF, IDS, Netflow, Packet Analyzer and Endpoint Detection \& Response tools.
* Understanding of web application security vulnerabilities, such as cross\-site scripting, cross\-site request forgery, SQL injection, denial\-of\-service attacks, and API attacks.
* Good understanding of Web Application Security risks.
* Excellent understanding of DDoS techniques and mitigation mechanisms.
* Display great problem\-solving skills, with tenacity and resilience to resolve issues.
* Excellent communication and presentation skills with proven skill in presenting analytical data effectively to varied audiences.
* Strong interpersonal and leadership skills to influence and build credibility as a peer.
* Strong understanding of cloud technologies and related security best practices.

Kura Sushi USA is a publicly traded U.S. company established in 2008 as a subsidiary of Kura Sushi, Inc. We are an innovative and tech interactive Japanese restaurant chain serving up the ultimate eater\-tainment dining experience with a combination of premium ingredients, advanced technology, and affordable prices to create a one\-of\-a\-kind revolving sushi dining experience. **Come join the Kura Krew!**

**This position is based in Irvine, CA and requires candidates to reside within a reasonable commuting distance of our Irvine office. Members are expected to work onsite a minimum of one day per week, with additional in\-office presence required based on division responsibilities and business needs. This is not a remote position.**  

  

**The GRC (Governance Risk \& Compliance) Senior Security Analyst** will be responsible for safeguarding Kura’s IT (Information Technology) infrastructure by monitoring security systems, conducting vulnerability assessments, and responding to security incidents under the direction of the Integrated GRC Senior Manager. This includes but not limited to monitoring activity throughout the Kura Sushi USA (“Kura”) environments and responding to security alerts in real time; Analyzing system logs, intrusion detection alerts, and suspicious activity; conducting vulnerability assessments and penetration testing; providing guidance on firewall security configurations, Intrusion Prevention System (IPS)/Intrusion Detection System (IDS), and endpoint protection systems; Investigating and documenting security incidents, including root cause analysis; developing and enforcing security and data governance via policies, procedures, and compliance standards; collaborating with ACAS and IT teams to strengthen security controls; and provide cybersecurity training and awareness to staff.
  

  

**DUTIES:** Key responsibilities include but not limited to:
  

* Forensic Analysis: Conduct forensic analysis of Security Information Event Management (SIEM), environment telemetry or log events to identify security incidents and vulnerabilities.
* Security Solutions: Evaluate, recommend, and implement security solutions to enhance core security capabilities, including access management and network security.
* Incident Response: Monitor security networks for breaches, respond to incidents, and conduct thorough investigations to mitigate risks.
* Vulnerability Assessments: Perform periodic vulnerability assessments and threat hunting to identify and address potential security weaknesses.
* Collaboration: Work closely with IT teams to ensure secure system configurations and compliance with security policies.
* Reporting: Prepare regular security reports for management, detailing findings and recommendations for improvements.
* Training: Conduct security awareness training for staff to promote a culture of security within the organization.

1\. Ensures the organization complies with all applicable security laws, regulations, and internal security policies. as it relates to security. This includes monitoring business operations and reporting any infractions.
  

2\. Partners with other members of the GRC team, Head of Department (HOD) of IT and other members of management where/when applicable. 3\. Policy Development: Create, modify, and implement enterprise\-wide security policies and procedures.
  

4\. Risk Management: Develop risk management strategies and conduct regular assessments to identify areas of potential non\-compliance.
  

5\. Training and Education: Design and deliver training programs for employees to ensure they understand compliance requirements and the importance of adhering to them.
  

6\. Liaison with Regulatory Bodies: Act as the point of contact between the organization and regulatory agencies, handling inspections and assessments.
  

7\. Incident Management: Perform assigned duties within the incident response plan. Investigate compliance breaches, conduct root cause analysis, and implement corrective actions to prevent recurrence.
  

8\. Provides regular reports to the VP of ACAS and applicable senior management security posture.
  

9\. Conducts annual security risk assessments
  

10\. Reviews contracts containing Personal Identifiable Information (PII) and system components to ensure Data Processing Agreements (DPAs) are issued to 3rd party vendors.
  

11\. Performs security assessments/reviews, monitors compliance deficiencies/remediation efforts, conducting/leading security investigations.**Security Governance, Risk and Compliance (GRC)**  

1\. Provides guidance to other members of ACAS Information Technology management in building a strong IT/Security compliant environment including guiding and mentoring direct and indirect team members.
  

2\. Providing guidance and facilitating coordination with cross\-functional members in implementing processes such as Security and IT governance, risk, and compliance activities to automate and facilitate continuous monitoring of information security controls, exceptions, risks, and testing.
  

3\. Contributes to the development and implementation of the Data Governance program, as directed by the Integrated GRC Senior Manager.

**Description**


The Senior Program Manager (PM) will be the single point of authority, responsible for Performance, Cost and Schedule for an Enterprise Information Technology program for \~$30M annually for a Federally Funded Research and Development Center (FFRDC) enterprise. The PM will lead a workforce of staff and subcontractors that will deliver a 24x7 Service Desk, advanced AI\-enabled tools, efficient on\-site deskside support, and complementary engineering, cybersecurity, and IT Service Management (ITSM) development resources. The PM provides a robust and highly available IT infrastructure required for the continuity and success of critical, nationally significant missions leveraging AI\-enabled capabilities, shared managed services capabilities, industry leading best practices and innovative processes to optimize financial resources and reduce cost.

**Primary Responsibilities:**

* Program Leadership and Contract: Directly responsible overall performance, cost and schedule for all program scope including Transition\-In, steady\-state Operations \& Maintenance, Innovation Projects, and Transition\-Out. Maintain full authority to act on all contract requirements and expediently address customer needs.
* Program and Team Governance: Establish and operate the Program Management Office, including program leadership, contract management, financial management, subcontract management, risk management and quality assurance. This includes emphasis on ISO 9001:2015, ISO/IEC 20000\-1:2018 ITSM, ISO 27001:2022 ISMS and CMMC 2\.0 processes, procedures, operational, risk and quality management.
* Subcontract Management: provide oversight of the subcontract program manager to meet and exceed FFRDC client small business requirements to deliver positive federal agency Contractor Performance Assessment Reporting System (CPARS) scores.
* Strategy and Culture: Lead the PMO, Operational and Technical Teams that provide strategy and vision that integrate multiple functions and sustain a high performance self\-driven team culture. This includes integration and partnerships with the client CIO organization, other IT contractors, IT vendors and Original Equipment Manufacturer (OEM) providers, including multiple support organizations.
* Customer Engagement: Engage and integrate with customers and stakeholders using a scheduled and on\-demand tempo to ensure customer service excellence and consistent delivery meeting and exceeding client expectations.
* Financial Management: Manage program financials to meet or exceed defined targets and apply Financial Operations (FinOps) to manage and minimize any unexpected or wasteful costs.
* Establish and manage integrated program schedules, forecasts, risks, issues, SLAs, KPIs, and performance baselines to proactively identify emerging challenges, implement mitigation actions, and consistently achieve customer mission, cost, schedule, quality, and service\-level outcomes.
* Recruit, retain, develop, and optimize a high\-performing workforce across Leidos and subcontractor organizations; ensure appropriate staffing, succession planning, training, employee engagement, and effective utilization of labor and non\-labor resources.
* Lead a data\-driven innovation and continuous\-improvement roadmap that leverages AI, automation, shared services, OEM partnerships, and Leidos Centers of Excellence to improve customer experience, increase operational efficiency, modernize service delivery, and deliver measurable cost savings.

**Basic Qualification:**

* Bachelors degree and 12\+ years of progressive leadership managing large\-scale federal IT infrastructure and operations programs
* 5\+ years of experience interfacing and presenting to C\-level executives
* Have extensive experience of leading programs of at least $25M annual value, at least 5,000 users, and across multiple geographic locations.
* Previous experience working in National Aeronautics and Space Administration (NASA) and Federal Agencies supporting Firm Fixed Price (FFP), Fixed Unit Rate (FUR) and other managed services contracts.
* Provide experience leading 50 to 100 Contractors and Subcontractors.
* 3\+ years of experience in managing AI\-enabled capabilities, IT managed services, managed shared services and enhancing ServiceNow operations and development.
* Demonstrated track record delivering cost savings through continuous improvements, automation, and FinOps.
* Experience with implementing and operating Zero\-Trust security, FedRAMP/FISMA compliance, and supporting ATOs for Moderate or higher systems
* Proven ability to brief and influence C\-level and FFRDC senior executives.
* 12\+ years of PM experience, which may include 5\+ years of experience serving in a DPM capacity.
* U.S. citizenship
* Must have the ability to obtain/maintain Public\-Trust clearance (Tier 2 moderate risk) within 30 days of onboarding

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Master’s degree (M.S., M.Eng., MBA, or equivalent) in IT Management, Cybersecurity, or Business Administration.
* Two or more of these advanced certifications: SAFe Agile, ITIL v4, CISSP/CISM/GSEC, AWS Cloud Certification, ServiceNow Certification, Microsoft 365 Certification, FinOps Practitioner, and Lean Six Sigma Black Belt
* 2\+ years leading AI/Gen\-AI, RPA, or AIOps deployments in a federal environment.
* Experience establishing or running a consolidated enterprise PMO and ISO 9001, ISO/IEC 20000, ISO 27001, CMMC or CMMI Level 3\+ service\-delivery organization. Prior management of a 24x7 operation in a FFP managed services environment.
* PMP certification

new_jobs.title: Senior Technical Program Manager, Connected Warfare (Active Clearance)
new_jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century's most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril's family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI\-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting\-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

**ABOUT THE TEAM**
------------------



The Connected Warfare First Party team focuses on increasing value to our customers through dedicated partnership with other internal divisions. The Connected Warfare division builds cutting\-edge technology spanning communications, networking, computing, and intelligent C2 software. Our mission is to foster strong relationships throughout our many Anduril teams to ensure that customer challenges are met with unified and innovative solutions.


**ABOUT THE JOB**
-----------------



We are seeking a Technical Program Manager who excels at building and nurturing internal relationships. You will be the key liaison that connects diverse Anduril business lines to foster collaboration, drive mutual success, and enhance customer outcomes.  

  

**Orchestrate Internal Collaboration.** Build and maintain strong working relationships across departments (engineering, product, supply chain, logistics, and growth). Facilitate clear communication and align strategic priorities to create a unified approach to customer missions.  

  

**Drive Customer Success through Partnership.** Act as the internal advocate for customer needs by sharing feedback and insights with relevant teams. Collaborate with stakeholders to identify and capitalize on opportunities that benefit Anduril and our customers.  

  

**Enhance Product Deployment.** Oversee the planning and execution of Anduril product deployments with seamless integration. Gather user feedback and work with engineering teams to refine offerings and meet mission requirements.  

  

**Foster a Culture of Teamwork.** Serve as the central contact for bridging gaps between internal teams. Seek to deeply understand and represent partnership interests, driving initiatives that enhance internal synergy.


**WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR**
--------------------------


**Mission First Mindset**. We put the needs of the mission and our customers first and understand that the US and its allies have no preordained right to victory in any future conflict. We actively seek out opportunities to better understand our customers' mission needs, with a goal to build the best possible products for the warfighter and radically evolve our national and international defense capabilities. We push ourselves and the limits of our capabilities in the pursuit of this goal.  

  

**Ownership Mentality.** We're looking for owners; those who have a natural bias to assume responsibility, a healthy dose of skepticism, and contribute to a culture of performance. We empower our Mission Operators to quickly assume high levels of responsibility and entrust them to actively own their account and shape its success. Our Mission Operators are just as comfortable helping to shape a proposal or pitch a new customer as they are working with engineers on new features or deploying products in the field.  

  

**Technical Aptitude and Intellectual Curiosity.** We are first and foremost a technology company, working at the leading edge of capabilities like machine learning, autonomy, distributed networking, and multi\-modal sensor fusion. MUSE is Promise's studio operating system, the platform our productions run on. It is built across product, pipeline, and infrastructure while live productions run on it.


As Program Manager, you lead the execution of the MUSE program across all three areas: planning, dependency and risk management, decision tracking, and the operating rhythm that keeps engineering, pipeline, infrastructure, and production aligned. Product sets priorities and defines what gets built; you own the plan that delivers it, with clear owners, milestones, and dates.

**Key Responsibilities**

* Own end\-to\-end execution of the MUSE program: scope, milestones, schedule, and delivery across product, pipeline, and infrastructure.

About the Role

Turn complex business questions into clear insights—and help move client engagements from research to delivery.

Currency Advisory Group is looking for a **Lead Business Analyst** who combines strong analytical thinking with disciplined execution. You will lead research and analytical workstreams, translate evidence into actionable insights, develop client\-facing presentations and reports, and coordinate the day\-to\-day work that keeps engagements moving forward.

Working closely with our founding partners, Managing Director, and Operations team, you will explore questions spanning business strategy, markets, culture, consumers, competition, organizations, and operations. You will bring structure to ambiguity, connect findings across different sources, and help clients understand what the evidence means for their business.

We are looking for someone who is both a **thinker and a driver**: someone who forms hypotheses, challenges assumptions, identifies what is missing, and moves work toward a clear conclusion. This is not simply a research\-support, note\-taking, or project\-status role.

What You’ll Do

* **Structure business questions and lead research.** Translate broad client needs into clear questions, hypotheses, research plans, and analytical workstreams. Conduct market, cultural, consumer, competitive, organizational, and strategic research using client materials, stakeholder interviews, external sources, and approved tools.
* **Turn evidence into meaningful insights.** Analyze qualitative and quantitative information, including interviews, documents, survey results, financial information, market data, and operational performance. Develop comparisons, basic models, forecasts, and visualizations. Identify patterns, contradictions, risks, and opportunities, and develop preliminary conclusions for senior review.
* **Build compelling client deliverables.** Produce complete first drafts of presentations, reports, research summaries, strategic frameworks, recommendations, interview guides, and workshop materials. Create clear narratives that explain what was learned, why it matters, and which decisions or actions the client should consider.
* **Own the day\-to\-day coordination of assigned workstreams.** Maintain workplans, deadlines, dependencies, review schedules, action logs, and outstanding decisions. * **Work directly with client teams.** Prepare agendas and pre\-reads, document decisions, coordinate follow\-up, and manage routine client communication. Lead analytical working sessions within agreed objectives, present research findings or assigned sections of deliverables, and keep client working teams informed.
* **Coordinate contributors and protect quality.** Provide task direction and feedback to assigned junior analysts, researchers, contractors, and external specialists. Review work for factual accuracy, analytical consistency, clarity, completeness, and citation integrity. Maintain organized evidence, source records, and version control.
* **Improve how the work gets done.** Maintain engagement knowledge and approved operating systems, including Sirano, Otter, research repositories, and collaboration tools. **Preferred Qualifications*** Master’s degree in Operations Research, Systems Engineering, Industrial Engineering, Data Science, Statistics, or a related discipline.
